items.summary: 从兵工厂小镇到英伟达核心圈：黄乐的人生轨迹与间谍疑云 Telegraph | 原文链接 | 频道大全
items.body:
孟建国, KEITH BRADSHER, 马语琴, 傅才德, ANA SWANSON2026年11月25日

The rows of matching yellow apartment blocks are each four stories tall and bear a name from another era: Patriotic Village No. 5.

一排排样式一致的黄色公寓楼，都是四层高，带着一个属于另一个时代的名字：爱国五村。

One of the weathered apartments belonged to the family of Alice Huang, whose father worked as a clerk at a sprawling complex of weapons factories in Nanzhushan, a village nestled in the hills of southern China’s Hunan Province.

其中一套略显斑驳的公寓曾属于黄乐(Alice Huang)的家庭，她的父亲曾在中国南部湖南省群山环抱的楠竹山镇一座庞大的兵工厂园区内当文员。

The complex had a number too: State-Owned Factory No. 282. It made everything from hand grenades to parts for guided missiles, and under China’s Soviet-style planned economy, life in the area revolved around it.

这座工厂综合体也有一个编号：国营282厂。它生产从手榴弹到制导导弹零部件的各类产品，在中国的苏式计划经济体制下，当地的生活都围绕着这座工厂运转。

Today, the town is well past its prime. The factory complex remains, but after state-owned enterprise layoffs, many young people started moving away. By the mid-2000s, one of them was Ms. Huang, who rose from this fading industrial town to the inner circle of the man behind America’s artificial intelligence boom — and into the middle of a geopolitical crisis.

如今，这座小镇早已风光不再。厂区依然存在，但在国有企业下岗潮之后，许多年轻人开始外迁。到2000年代中期，黄乐也成为其中之一，她从这座日渐衰落的工业小镇一路崛起，进入美国人工智能热潮推动者的核心圈子——并卷入了一场地缘政治危机的中心。

The New York Times traced Ms. Huang’s life through visits to Nanzhushan village and four countries, drawing on internal company documents, corporate filings and interviews with more than a dozen people familiar with her. Ms. Huang has not responded to requests for comment.

《纽约时报》通过走访楠竹山镇和四个国家，结合公司内部文件、企业备案资料以及对十余名熟悉她的人士的采访，追踪了黄乐的人生轨迹。黄乐未回应置评请求。

The reporting reveals previously unreported details of her upbringing, education and business dealings that show how Ms. Huang’s life has been intertwined with China’s military-industrial complex since childhood.

此次报道披露了她此前未曾公开的成长背景、教育经历和商业往来细节，揭示了她的人生自童年起便与中国军工复合体紧密交织。

U.S. intelligence officials believe Ms. Huang was in contact with an officer of China’s Ministry of State Security from the spring of 2025 through this year. That period overlapped with at least part of the time she allegedly had an affair with Jensen Huang, the chief executive of American chip giant Nvidia. It also coincided with large purchases of Nvidia’s advanced chips by her company Megaspeed. U.S. intelligence agencies have also gathered evidence that her business partner, Kang Wei, who was often introduced as her husband, worked with the same Chinese spy agency.

美国情报官员认为，从2025年春季到今年，黄乐一直与中国国家安全部的一名官员保持联系。这一时期与据称她和美国芯片巨头英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋保持婚外情的时间至少有部分重叠，也与她的Megaspeed公司大量采购英伟达先进芯片的时间相吻合。美国情报机构还收集了证据，表明她经常对外介绍为丈夫的商业伙伴康伟也与同一家中国情报机构有合作。

Those contacts led some U.S. officials to suspect that Mr. Huang, who resigned as Nvidia’s chief executive on Nov. 12, had been targeted in a Chinese intelligence operation, which Beijing denies. The case heightened concerns in Washington about Beijing’s efforts to acquire advanced American chips and accelerate its A.I. ambitions.

这些接触让一些美国官员怀疑，已于11月12日辞去英伟达首席执行官职务的黄仁勋曾是中国情报行动的目标，北京方面对此予以否认。这一案件加剧了华盛顿对北京试图获取美国先进芯片并加速其人工智能雄心的担忧。

The claims about Ms. Huang continue to reverberate. On Monday, in a stunning turnabout, Nvidia’s board of directors reinstated Mr. Huang as C.E.O. after pressure from President Trump. Despite the president’s support, Mr. Huang and his ties to Ms. Huang are expected to be scrutinized in Congress next week, when he is set to appear before three committees.

围绕黄乐的指控仍在持续发酵。周一发生了一场令人震惊的逆转，英伟达董事会在特朗普总统施压后恢复了黄仁勋的首席执行官职务。尽管有总统支持，黄仁勋及其与黄乐的关系预计仍将在下周受到国会审查，届时他将出席三个委员会的听证会。

在这些“爱国五村”小区的四层楼房中，有一套公寓曾属于黄乐的家庭。

Raised in a Weapons Town

兵工厂小镇的童年

Since childhood, her life was surrounded by China’s defense establishment. She attended a school for children of workers at a weapons factory owned by a state-run company repeatedly sanctioned by the U.S. government.

自儿时起，她的生活便被中国的国防体系所包围。她就读的是一所子弟学校，其中的学生是一家国有企业旗下的兵工厂职工子女，该企业曾屡次遭到美国政府制裁。

Ms. Huang had established her own ties to the Chinese government by the time she was an adult. She worked briefly for China’s state broadcaster and later made an investment that would connect her to the son of a former Chinese vice premier. As an entrepreneur, she remained within the state’s orbit, securing backing and funding from local government officials for a business that served Beijing’s strategic imperatives.

到成年时，黄乐已建立了自己与中国政府的联系。她曾在中国官方广播电视机构短暂工作，后来进行的一项投资使她与一位中国前副总理之子产生了交集。作为一名企业家，她始终处于体制的轨道之内，为一项服务于北京战略要务的业务赢得了地方政府官员的支持和资金。

Through a web of family and business relationships that gave her access to Nvidia chips, she is linked to Chinese state-owned defense contractors that supply the People’s Liberation Army.

通过一张让她得以获取英伟达芯片的家庭和商业关系网，她与为中国人民解放军供货的中国国有国防承包商保持了关联。

一座兵工厂综合体曾是楠竹山镇的主要雇主。其中一栋建筑上的红色横幅写着：“军民团结一家亲”。

The story of a factory worker’s daughter from rural China who found herself at the center of a global struggle over technology and espionage is one of ambition, reinvention and China’s rise from a drab socialist state to a shiny world power.

一个出身于中国乡间工厂的工人家庭之女发现自己进入了全球技术与间谍之争的中心——这是一个关于野心、自我重塑，以及中国从了无生气的社会主义国家崛起为光鲜世界大国的故事。

Alice Huang grew up in the shadow of Mao Zedong, whose birthplace is just a 20-minute drive away. Her father worked at the local plant, part of Jiangnan Industries Group, a subsidiary of the military supplier Norinco.

黄乐从小在毛泽东的影响下长大，他的出生地离她家仅20分钟车程。她的父亲在当地工厂工作，该厂隶属于军工供应商中国兵器工业集团旗下的江南工业集团。

She attended local schools, where she was a good student but not at the top of her class, according to the neighborhood committee cadre. She later enrolled in a nursing school in the nearby city of Xiangtan, according to a current student named Joanna, who said a teacher had described Alice Huang as a graduate.

据居委会干部介绍，她在当地学校就读，成绩不错，但并非名列前茅。她后来就读于邻近湘潭市的一所护理学校，据一名名叫乔安娜的在校学生说，一位老师曾提到黄乐是该校毕业生。

After graduating, Ms. Huang, who turns 44 next month, did what tens of millions of Chinese in her generation did. She left small-town life for better opportunities in bigger cities like Beijing and Shanghai.

毕业后，下个月将满44岁的黄乐做了她那一代数千万中国人都在做的事：离开小镇生活，前往北京、上海等大城市寻找更好的机会。

Over two decades, she became a globe-trotting executive overseeing Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company that bought billions of dollars’ worth of Nvidia’s advanced chips.

20多年来，她成长为一名奔走于世界各地的高管，执掌着总部位于新加坡的Megaspeed公司，该公司采购了价值数十亿美元的英伟达先进芯片。

Yet traces of her early life proved difficult to pin down. Villagers gossiped about the family, whom some remembered, but none could identify the precise house where she grew up. Local officials disagreed about her mother’s background.

然而，她早年生活的痕迹却难以捉摸。村民们对这家人议论纷纷，有些人还记得他们，但没人能指出她家的屋宅在哪。地方官员对她母亲的背景也说法不一。

Two Times journalists interviewed village leaders and several residents before the police halted their reporting and took them to the nearest police station for questioning.

时报的两名记者采访了村干部和几位村民，随后警方叫停了他们的采访，并将他们带到最近的派出所问话。

黄乐的父亲曾在该兵工厂担任文员，她就读于楠竹山镇一所为该厂职工子女开设的学校。

By her 20s, Alice Huang had left Nanzhushan. She worked for state television at the flagship channel of China’s state broadcaster, according to an online résumé and a former classmate.

20多岁时，黄乐已离开楠竹山镇。根据一份在线简历和一位前同学的说法，她曾在中国国家广播电视机构的旗舰频道工作。

She attended Hong Kong Baptist University in 2006 to pursue a master’s degree in media management. The program was new and drew many students from mainland China, who, one former professor recalled, were often there for reasons beyond education. Hong Kong was a gateway to the world, with open internet and easy travel.

2006年，她进入香港浸会大学攻读传媒管理硕士学位。该课程当时刚刚开设，吸引了许多来自中国内地的学生，一位前教授回忆说，他们来这里往往有着教育以外的目的。香港当时是通往世界的门户，拥有开放的互联网和便利的出行条件。

A classmate said she often wore designer brands, a contrast with the jeans and T-shirts most other students wore. She often skipped classes, the person said, and many students suspected that connections in China kept her in the school.

一位同学表示，她经常穿名牌服装，与大多数穿牛仔裤和T恤的学生形成鲜明对比。这名人士还说，她经常旷课，许多学生怀疑她在内地的关系网保住了她的学籍。

In 2010, she and her older sister, Huang Yu, registered a company at the address of a building inside a members-only golf course in Beijing. Their father, Huang Guobin, by then of retirement age, was listed as a company supervisor in Chinese corporate records.

2010年，她和姐姐黄瑜用北京一家会员制高尔夫球场内一座建筑的地址注册了一家公司。中国企业工商记录显示，当时已到退休年龄的父亲黄国斌被列为公司监事。

The golf course was a magnet for government officials and the businessmen who courted them. Its restaurant served shark fin, and its chef had worked at the walled compound where Chinese leaders host heads of state, according to Chinese media reports. A senior civil-aviation official was once punished for accepting more than 50 free rounds of golf there.

这家高尔夫球场是政府官员和巴结他们的商人的聚集地。据中国媒体报道，其餐厅供应鱼翅，厨师曾在中国领导人接待外国元首的国宾馆工作。一名民航系统高级官员曾因在该球场接受超过50次免费高尔夫球服务而受到处分。

It is unclear what the Huang family business did. It reported taking in only about $4,500 in 2012. In 2014, Alice transferred her stake to her sister.

目前尚不清楚黄家这家公司的具体业务。该公司申报2012年的收入仅约4500美元。2014年，黄乐将自己的股份转让给了姐姐。

Soon, the Huang sisters moved on to far larger ventures.

不久，黄氏姐妹便转向了规模大得多的商业项目。

The Data Center Highway

数据中心高速公路

Alice Huang’s hometown Nanzhushan sits next to the G60 expressway. Follow it some 700 miles to the northeast and it ends in Shanghai, passing in its final miles by a cluster of giant data centers in the city’s Songjiang District.

黄乐的家乡楠竹山镇紧邻G60高速公路。沿这条公路向东北方向行驶约1200公里，终点便是上海，并且在最后的路段经过该市松江区的一处大型数据中心集群。

There, she made her mark with a sprawling data center featuring advanced American A.I. chips. The project also brought her into the orbit of Nvidia’s Mr. Huang.

在那里，她凭借一座配备美国先进人工智能芯片的大型数据中心崭露头角。该项目也将她带入了英伟达的黄仁勋的社交圈。

Alice Huang was in Shanghai by the mid-2010s. In meetings, she introduced a well-known financier, Kang Wei, as her husband. Together, they invested in a network of companies with overlapping ownership, shareholders and contact information, according to corporate filings and records from WireScreen, a data platform.

到2000年代中期，黄乐已身处上海。在商务会面中，她将知名金融家康伟介绍为自己的丈夫。企业备案资料和数据平台WireScreen的记录显示，两人共同投资了一系列在所有权、股东和联系信息上存在重叠的公司。

She put her money alongside some of China’s most sophisticated and politically connected financiers. At one point, she used a Caribbean shell company to invest in a Chinese medical device maker before its public share sale, according to a filing with the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. Among the other investors was a fund founded by the son of Liu He, who was then a vice premier of China and a member of the Communist Party’s ruling Politburo.

她与一些中国最精明、政治人脉最广的金融家共同出资。根据提交给香港交易所的一份文件，她曾通过一家加勒比空壳公司在一家中国医疗器械制造商公开募股前对其进行投资。其他投资者中包括时任中国副总理、中共中央政治局委员的刘鹤的儿子所创立的一只基金。

黄乐和康伟参与开发了这座位于上海西郊的数据中心。场地周围的围墙顶部装有电网。

Alice Huang initially owned a key holding company for the network. In 2017, as with the golf company, she transferred her stake to her older sister.

黄乐最初拥有该商业网络一家核心控股公司的股权。2017年，与高尔夫公司如出一辙，她将股份转让给了姐姐。

During Covid, Alice Huang and Mr. Kang helped develop a data center with local government support — a project that made her a potentially useful contact for State Security. When it was finished, the project, called the Yangtze River Delta A.I. Advanced Computing Center, featured Nvidia chips and leased computing power to companies.

新冠疫情期间，黄乐和康伟在地方政府支持下参与开发了一座数据中心——这一项目使她成为国家安全部门眼中有潜在利用价值的联络对象。该项目名为长三角人工智能超算中心，建成后配备了英伟达芯片，并向企业出租算力。

The data center and a company set up to acquire Nvidia servers and rent out computing power, called Century Litong, soon became a key link in a chip supply pipeline. The flows traveled into a network of companies linked to Chinese military contractors like the Aviation Industry Corporation of China, China’s state aerospace and defense conglomerate, and an A.I. lab linked to the People’s Liberation Army.

这座数据中心以及一家为采购英伟达服务器并出租算力而成立的名为世纪利通的公司很快成为芯片供应渠道中的关键一环。这些芯片流向了一个企业网络，其中包括中国国有航空航天与国防企业集团中国航空工业集团等中国军工承包商，以及一家与中国人民解放军有关联的人工智能实验室。

As borders reopened after the pandemic, the couple looked abroad. In 2022, Nvidia’s sales team had introduced Alice Huang to the Chinese technology giant Alibaba. She and Mr. Kang began pitching investors on a venture to buy Nvidia chips, install them in Southeast Asia and sell the A.I. computing power to Chinese companies.

随着疫情后跨境往来恢复，这对伴侣将目光投向了海外。2022年，英伟达的销售团队将黄乐介绍给了中国科技巨头阿里巴巴。她和康伟开始向投资者推介一个项目，计划购买英伟达芯片并部署在东南亚，再向中国企业出售人工智能算力。

Megaspeed位于新加坡的办公室。该公司采购了价值数十亿美元的英伟达先进人工智能芯片。

In 2023, Alice Huang used a British Virgin Islands company to buy a Singaporean subsidiary of 7Road, a gaming company. It became Megaspeed.

2023年，黄乐通过一家英属维尔京群岛公司收购了游戏公司第七大道旗下的一家新加坡子公司。该公司随后更名为Megaspeed。

The U.S. government had begun tightening restrictions on sales of advanced A.I. chips to China, prompting companies to eliminate ties to the mainland. Alice Huang began cultivating an image as an international executive. She posted pictures of herself drinking wine at fine restaurants across Asia alongside Nvidia’s Mr. Huang and tycoons from the region’s chip and electronics supply chain.

美国政府当时已开始收紧对华销售先进人工智能芯片的限制，促使相关企业切断与中国大陆的联系。黄乐开始塑造自己作为国际化高管的形象。她在社交媒体上发布自己在亚洲各地高档餐厅饮酒的照片，身旁正是英伟达的黄仁勋以及该地区芯片和电子供应链的商界大亨。

To those around them, their China connections were obvious. In one pitch deck from 2025, their data center business heralded computing centers operating in Shanghai, Shenzhen, Anhui, Sichuan, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia — a mix of locations that tied a data center network in China to one in Southeast Asia, where the most advanced Nvidia chips could be bought.

对周围的人而言，他们与中国的联系显而易见。在2025年的一份融资推介演示文稿中，他们的数据中心业务宣传了在上海、深圳、安徽、四川以及马来西亚、泰国和印度尼西亚运营的计算中心——这种布局将中国境内的数据中心网络与东南亚网络联系在一起，而在东南亚可以买到最先进的英伟达芯片。

Although the relationship with Mr. Huang was not yet public, U.S. intelligence agencies had identified Alice Huang as an asset of China’s Ministry of State Security. By the fall of 2025, President Trump had been briefed on the intelligence.

尽管她与黄仁勋的关系当时尚未公开，但美国情报机构已认定黄乐为中国国家安全部的线人。到2025年秋季，特朗普总统已听取了有关该情报的简报。

2024年6月，黄仁勋与黄乐相邻而坐，摄于台湾台北。

‘We Are All Gossiping.’

“大家都在议论这件事。”

Alice Huang’s newfound prominence has reached Nanzhushan.

黄乐新近获得的知名度已经传到了楠竹山镇。

One store manager said locals had been discussing the news quietly. Although coverage has not been widely censored, the subject remains sensitive.

一家商店经理表示，当地人一直在私下议论这一消息。尽管相关报道尚未遭到大范围审查，但这一话题依然敏感。

In Patriotic Village No. 5, people were less cautious.

在爱国五村，人们的顾忌则少得多。

“We are all gossiping about it,” admitted a neighbor surnamed Zheng, who once made hand grenades at the factory. Another resident said many had been discussing her looks.

“大家都在议论这件事，”一位曾在厂里制造手榴弹的郑姓邻居坦言。另一位居民说，很多人一直在讨论她的长相。

In nearby Xiangtan, a man surnamed Han said he looked up to Alice Huang. Times have been tough, and it was becoming harder for local people to make money, he said. That a homegrown person could get rich was impressive.

在邻近的湘潭，一位姓韩的男子表示他很钦佩黄乐。他说，如今世道艰难，当地人赚钱越来越不容易，一个本土出身的人能够发家致富，令人印象深刻。

“I don’t care if she is the mistress of Jensen Huang,” he said. “She is great because she is a successful businesswoman.”

“我不在乎她是不是黄仁勋的情妇，”他说。“我觉得她挺厉害的，因为她是一个成功的生意人。”

艾莎(Alexandra Stevenson)、Selam Gebrekidan、 Murphy Zhao和Anjali Tsui自香港、Xinyun Wu和Pei-Lin Wu自台湾台北对本文有报道贡献。Ruoxin Zhang对本文有研究贡献。

孟建国(Paul Mozur)是时报全球科技记者，常驻台北。此前，他自香港、上海和首尔报道亚洲科技与政治的交叉议题。

Keith Bradsher是《纽约时报》北京分社社长，此前曾任上海分社社长、香港分社社长、底特律分社社长，以及华盛顿记者。他在新冠疫情期间常驻中国进行报道。

Mara Hvistendahl是国际新闻版块调查记者，可以通过电邮mara.hvistendahl@nytimes.com与她联系。

傅才德(Michael Forsythe)是《纽约时报》调查记者，常驻纽约。他此前曾驻中国，广泛报道该国各类议题。

Ana Swanson报道贸易和国际经济新闻，常驻华盛顿。她从事新闻工作已超过十年。

blocks.text: 孟建国, KEITH BRADSHER, 马语琴, 傅才德, ANA SWANSON2026年11月25日
The rows of matching yellow apartment blocks are each four stories tall and bear a name from another era: Patriotic Village No. 5.
一排排样式一致的黄色公寓楼，都是四层高，带着一个属于另一个时代的名字：爱国五村。

One of the weathered apartments belonged to the family of Alice Huang, whose father worked as a clerk at a sprawling complex of weapons factories in Nanzhushan, a village nestled in the hills of southern China’s Hunan Province.
其中一套略显斑驳的公寓曾属于黄乐(Alice Huang)的家庭，她的父亲曾在中国南部湖南省群山环抱的楠竹山镇一座庞大的兵工厂园区内当文员。

The complex had a number too: State-Owned Factory No. 282. It made everything from hand grenades to parts for guided missiles, and under China’s Soviet-style planned economy, life in the area revolved around it.
这座工厂综合体也有一个编号：国营282厂。它生产从手榴弹到制导导弹零部件的各类产品，在中国的苏式计划经济体制下，当地的生活都围绕着这座工厂运转。

Today, the town is well past its prime. The factory complex remains, but after state-owned enterprise layoffs, many young people started moving away. By the mid-2000s, one of them was Ms. Huang, who rose from this fading industrial town to the inner circle of the man behind America’s artificial intelligence boom — and into the middle of a geopolitical crisis.
如今，这座小镇早已风光不再。厂区依然存在，但在国有企业下岗潮之后，许多年轻人开始外迁。到2000年代中期，黄乐也成为其中之一，她从这座日渐衰落的工业小镇一路崛起，进入美国人工智能热潮推动者的核心圈子——并卷入了一场地缘政治危机的中心。

The New York Times traced Ms. Huang’s life through visits to Nanzhushan village and four countries, drawing on internal company documents, corporate filings and interviews with more than a dozen people familiar with her. Ms. Huang has not responded to requests for comment.
《纽约时报》通过走访楠竹山镇和四个国家，结合公司内部文件、企业备案资料以及对十余名熟悉她的人士的采访，追踪了黄乐的人生轨迹。黄乐未回应置评请求。

The reporting reveals previously unreported details of her upbringing, education and business dealings that show how Ms. Huang’s life has been intertwined with China’s military-industrial complex since childhood.
此次报道披露了她此前未曾公开的成长背景、教育经历和商业往来细节，揭示了她的人生自童年起便与中国军工复合体紧密交织。

U.S. intelligence officials believe Ms. Huang was in contact with an officer of China’s Ministry of State Security from the spring of 2025 through this year. That period overlapped with at least part of the time she allegedly had an affair with Jensen Huang, the chief executive of American chip giant Nvidia. It also coincided with large purchases of Nvidia’s advanced chips by her company Megaspeed. U.S. intelligence agencies have also gathered evidence that her business partner, Kang Wei, who was often introduced as her husband, worked with the same Chinese spy agency.
美国情报官员认为，从2025年春季到今年，黄乐一直与中国国家安全部的一名官员保持联系。这一时期与据称她和美国芯片巨头英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋保持婚外情的时间至少有部分重叠，也与她的Megaspeed公司大量采购英伟达先进芯片的时间相吻合。美国情报机构还收集了证据，表明她经常对外介绍为丈夫的商业伙伴康伟也与同一家中国情报机构有合作。

Those contacts led some U.S. officials to suspect that Mr. Huang, who resigned as Nvidia’s chief executive on Nov. 12, had been targeted in a Chinese intelligence operation, which Beijing denies. The case heightened concerns in Washington about Beijing’s efforts to acquire advanced American chips and accelerate its A.I. ambitions.
这些接触让一些美国官员怀疑，已于11月12日辞去英伟达首席执行官职务的黄仁勋曾是中国情报行动的目标，北京方面对此予以否认。这一案件加剧了华盛顿对北京试图获取美国先进芯片并加速其人工智能雄心的担忧。

The claims about Ms. Huang continue to reverberate. On Monday, in a stunning turnabout, Nvidia’s board of directors reinstated Mr. Huang as C.E.O. after pressure from President Trump. Despite the president’s support, Mr. Huang and his ties to Ms. Huang are expected to be scrutinized in Congress next week, when he is set to appear before three committees.
围绕黄乐的指控仍在持续发酵。周一发生了一场令人震惊的逆转，英伟达董事会在特朗普总统施压后恢复了黄仁勋的首席执行官职务。尽管有总统支持，黄仁勋及其与黄乐的关系预计仍将在下周受到国会审查，届时他将出席三个委员会的听证会。
在这些“爱国五村”小区的四层楼房中，有一套公寓曾属于黄乐的家庭。
Raised in a Weapons Town
兵工厂小镇的童年

Since childhood, her life was surrounded by China’s defense establishment. She attended a school for children of workers at a weapons factory owned by a state-run company repeatedly sanctioned by the U.S. government.
自儿时起，她的生活便被中国的国防体系所包围。她就读的是一所子弟学校，其中的学生是一家国有企业旗下的兵工厂职工子女，该企业曾屡次遭到美国政府制裁。

Ms. Huang had established her own ties to the Chinese government by the time she was an adult. She worked briefly for China’s state broadcaster and later made an investment that would connect her to the son of a former Chinese vice premier. As an entrepreneur, she remained within the state’s orbit, securing backing and funding from local government officials for a business that served Beijing’s strategic imperatives.
到成年时，黄乐已建立了自己与中国政府的联系。她曾在中国官方广播电视机构短暂工作，后来进行的一项投资使她与一位中国前副总理之子产生了交集。作为一名企业家，她始终处于体制的轨道之内，为一项服务于北京战略要务的业务赢得了地方政府官员的支持和资金。
Through a web of family and business relationships that gave her access to Nvidia chips, she is linked to Chinese state-owned defense contractors that supply the People’s Liberation Army.
通过一张让她得以获取英伟达芯片的家庭和商业关系网，她与为中国人民解放军供货的中国国有国防承包商保持了关联。
一座兵工厂综合体曾是楠竹山镇的主要雇主。其中一栋建筑上的红色横幅写着：“军民团结一家亲”。

The story of a factory worker’s daughter from rural China who found herself at the center of a global struggle over technology and espionage is one of ambition, reinvention and China’s rise from a drab socialist state to a shiny world power.
一个出身于中国乡间工厂的工人家庭之女发现自己进入了全球技术与间谍之争的中心——这是一个关于野心、自我重塑，以及中国从了无生气的社会主义国家崛起为光鲜世界大国的故事。

Alice Huang grew up in the shadow of Mao Zedong, whose birthplace is just a 20-minute drive away. Her father worked at the local plant, part of Jiangnan Industries Group, a subsidiary of the military supplier Norinco.
黄乐从小在毛泽东的影响下长大，他的出生地离她家仅20分钟车程。她的父亲在当地工厂工作，该厂隶属于军工供应商中国兵器工业集团旗下的江南工业集团。

She attended local schools, where she was a good student but not at the top of her class, according to the neighborhood committee cadre. She later enrolled in a nursing school in the nearby city of Xiangtan, according to a current student named Joanna, who said a teacher had described Alice Huang as a graduate.
据居委会干部介绍，她在当地学校就读，成绩不错，但并非名列前茅。她后来就读于邻近湘潭市的一所护理学校，据一名名叫乔安娜的在校学生说，一位老师曾提到黄乐是该校毕业生。

After graduating, Ms. Huang, who turns 44 next month, did what tens of millions of Chinese in her generation did. She left small-town life for better opportunities in bigger cities like Beijing and Shanghai.
毕业后，下个月将满44岁的黄乐做了她那一代数千万中国人都在做的事：离开小镇生活，前往北京、上海等大城市寻找更好的机会。
Over two decades, she became a globe-trotting executive overseeing Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company that bought billions of dollars’ worth of Nvidia’s advanced chips.
20多年来，她成长为一名奔走于世界各地的高管，执掌着总部位于新加坡的Megaspeed公司，该公司采购了价值数十亿美元的英伟达先进芯片。

Yet traces of her early life proved difficult to pin down. Villagers gossiped about the family, whom some remembered, but none could identify the precise house where she grew up. Local officials disagreed about her mother’s background.
然而，她早年生活的痕迹却难以捉摸。村民们对这家人议论纷纷，有些人还记得他们，但没人能指出她家的屋宅在哪。地方官员对她母亲的背景也说法不一。
Two Times journalists interviewed village leaders and several residents before the police halted their reporting and took them to the nearest police station for questioning.
时报的两名记者采访了村干部和几位村民，随后警方叫停了他们的采访，并将他们带到最近的派出所问话。
黄乐的父亲曾在该兵工厂担任文员，她就读于楠竹山镇一所为该厂职工子女开设的学校。
By her 20s, Alice Huang had left Nanzhushan. She worked for state television at the flagship channel of China’s state broadcaster, according to an online résumé and a former classmate.
20多岁时，黄乐已离开楠竹山镇。根据一份在线简历和一位前同学的说法，她曾在中国国家广播电视机构的旗舰频道工作。

She attended Hong Kong Baptist University in 2006 to pursue a master’s degree in media management. The program was new and drew many students from mainland China, who, one former professor recalled, were often there for reasons beyond education. Hong Kong was a gateway to the world, with open internet and easy travel.
2006年，她进入香港浸会大学攻读传媒管理硕士学位。该课程当时刚刚开设，吸引了许多来自中国内地的学生，一位前教授回忆说，他们来这里往往有着教育以外的目的。香港当时是通往世界的门户，拥有开放的互联网和便利的出行条件。

A classmate said she often wore designer brands, a contrast with the jeans and T-shirts most other students wore. She often skipped classes, the person said, and many students suspected that connections in China kept her in the school.
一位同学表示，她经常穿名牌服装，与大多数穿牛仔裤和T恤的学生形成鲜明对比。这名人士还说，她经常旷课，许多学生怀疑她在内地的关系网保住了她的学籍。

In 2010, she and her older sister, Huang Yu, registered a company at the address of a building inside a members-only golf course in Beijing. Their father, Huang Guobin, by then of retirement age, was listed as a company supervisor in Chinese corporate records.
2010年，她和姐姐黄瑜用北京一家会员制高尔夫球场内一座建筑的地址注册了一家公司。中国企业工商记录显示，当时已到退休年龄的父亲黄国斌被列为公司监事。

The golf course was a magnet for government officials and the businessmen who courted them. Its restaurant served shark fin, and its chef had worked at the walled compound where Chinese leaders host heads of state, according to Chinese media reports. A senior civil-aviation official was once punished for accepting more than 50 free rounds of golf there.
这家高尔夫球场是政府官员和巴结他们的商人的聚集地。据中国媒体报道，其餐厅供应鱼翅，厨师曾在中国领导人接待外国元首的国宾馆工作。一名民航系统高级官员曾因在该球场接受超过50次免费高尔夫球服务而受到处分。
It is unclear what the Huang family business did. It reported taking in only about $4,500 in 2012. In 2014, Alice transferred her stake to her sister.
目前尚不清楚黄家这家公司的具体业务。该公司申报2012年的收入仅约4500美元。2014年，黄乐将自己的股份转让给了姐姐。
Soon, the Huang sisters moved on to far larger ventures.
不久，黄氏姐妹便转向了规模大得多的商业项目。
The Data Center Highway
数据中心高速公路

Alice Huang’s hometown Nanzhushan sits next to the G60 expressway. Follow it some 700 miles to the northeast and it ends in Shanghai, passing in its final miles by a cluster of giant data centers in the city’s Songjiang District.
黄乐的家乡楠竹山镇紧邻G60高速公路。沿这条公路向东北方向行驶约1200公里，终点便是上海，并且在最后的路段经过该市松江区的一处大型数据中心集群。
There, she made her mark with a sprawling data center featuring advanced American A.I. chips. The project also brought her into the orbit of Nvidia’s Mr. Huang.
在那里，她凭借一座配备美国先进人工智能芯片的大型数据中心崭露头角。该项目也将她带入了英伟达的黄仁勋的社交圈。

Alice Huang was in Shanghai by the mid-2010s. In meetings, she introduced a well-known financier, Kang Wei, as her husband. Together, they invested in a network of companies with overlapping ownership, shareholders and contact information, according to corporate filings and records from WireScreen, a data platform.
到2000年代中期，黄乐已身处上海。在商务会面中，她将知名金融家康伟介绍为自己的丈夫。企业备案资料和数据平台WireScreen的记录显示，两人共同投资了一系列在所有权、股东和联系信息上存在重叠的公司。

She put her money alongside some of China’s most sophisticated and politically connected financiers. At one point, she used a Caribbean shell company to invest in a Chinese medical device maker before its public share sale, according to a filing with the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. Among the other investors was a fund founded by the son of Liu He, who was then a vice premier of China and a member of the Communist Party’s ruling Politburo.
她与一些中国最精明、政治人脉最广的金融家共同出资。根据提交给香港交易所的一份文件，她曾通过一家加勒比空壳公司在一家中国医疗器械制造商公开募股前对其进行投资。其他投资者中包括时任中国副总理、中共中央政治局委员的刘鹤的儿子所创立的一只基金。
黄乐和康伟参与开发了这座位于上海西郊的数据中心。场地周围的围墙顶部装有电网。
Alice Huang initially owned a key holding company for the network. In 2017, as with the golf company, she transferred her stake to her older sister.
黄乐最初拥有该商业网络一家核心控股公司的股权。2017年，与高尔夫公司如出一辙，她将股份转让给了姐姐。

During Covid, Alice Huang and Mr. Kang helped develop a data center with local government support — a project that made her a potentially useful contact for State Security. When it was finished, the project, called the Yangtze River Delta A.I. Advanced Computing Center, featured Nvidia chips and leased computing power to companies.
新冠疫情期间，黄乐和康伟在地方政府支持下参与开发了一座数据中心——这一项目使她成为国家安全部门眼中有潜在利用价值的联络对象。该项目名为长三角人工智能超算中心，建成后配备了英伟达芯片，并向企业出租算力。

The data center and a company set up to acquire Nvidia servers and rent out computing power, called Century Litong, soon became a key link in a chip supply pipeline. The flows traveled into a network of companies linked to Chinese military contractors like the Aviation Industry Corporation of China, China’s state aerospace and defense conglomerate, and an A.I. lab linked to the People’s Liberation Army.
这座数据中心以及一家为采购英伟达服务器并出租算力而成立的名为世纪利通的公司很快成为芯片供应渠道中的关键一环。这些芯片流向了一个企业网络，其中包括中国国有航空航天与国防企业集团中国航空工业集团等中国军工承包商，以及一家与中国人民解放军有关联的人工智能实验室。

As borders reopened after the pandemic, the couple looked abroad. In 2022, Nvidia’s sales team had introduced Alice Huang to the Chinese technology giant Alibaba. She and Mr. Kang began pitching investors on a venture to buy Nvidia chips, install them in Southeast Asia and sell the A.I. computing power to Chinese companies.
随着疫情后跨境往来恢复，这对伴侣将目光投向了海外。2022年，英伟达的销售团队将黄乐介绍给了中国科技巨头阿里巴巴。她和康伟开始向投资者推介一个项目，计划购买英伟达芯片并部署在东南亚，再向中国企业出售人工智能算力。
Megaspeed位于新加坡的办公室。该公司采购了价值数十亿美元的英伟达先进人工智能芯片。
In 2023, Alice Huang used a British Virgin Islands company to buy a Singaporean subsidiary of 7Road, a gaming company. It became Megaspeed.
2023年，黄乐通过一家英属维尔京群岛公司收购了游戏公司第七大道旗下的一家新加坡子公司。该公司随后更名为Megaspeed。

The U.S. government had begun tightening restrictions on sales of advanced A.I. chips to China, prompting companies to eliminate ties to the mainland. Alice Huang began cultivating an image as an international executive. She posted pictures of herself drinking wine at fine restaurants across Asia alongside Nvidia’s Mr. Huang and tycoons from the region’s chip and electronics supply chain.
美国政府当时已开始收紧对华销售先进人工智能芯片的限制，促使相关企业切断与中国大陆的联系。黄乐开始塑造自己作为国际化高管的形象。她在社交媒体上发布自己在亚洲各地高档餐厅饮酒的照片，身旁正是英伟达的黄仁勋以及该地区芯片和电子供应链的商界大亨。

To those around them, their China connections were obvious. In one pitch deck from 2025, their data center business heralded computing centers operating in Shanghai, Shenzhen, Anhui, Sichuan, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia — a mix of locations that tied a data center network in China to one in Southeast Asia, where the most advanced Nvidia chips could be bought.
对周围的人而言，他们与中国的联系显而易见。在2025年的一份融资推介演示文稿中，他们的数据中心业务宣传了在上海、深圳、安徽、四川以及马来西亚、泰国和印度尼西亚运营的计算中心——这种布局将中国境内的数据中心网络与东南亚网络联系在一起，而在东南亚可以买到最先进的英伟达芯片。

Although the relationship with Mr. Huang was not yet public, U.S. intelligence agencies had identified Alice Huang as an asset of China’s Ministry of State Security. By the fall of 2025, President Trump had been briefed on the intelligence.
尽管她与黄仁勋的关系当时尚未公开，但美国情报机构已认定黄乐为中国国家安全部的线人。到2025年秋季，特朗普总统已听取了有关该情报的简报。
2024年6月，黄仁勋与黄乐相邻而坐，摄于台湾台北。
‘We Are All Gossiping.’
“大家都在议论这件事。”
Alice Huang’s newfound prominence has reached Nanzhushan.
黄乐新近获得的知名度已经传到了楠竹山镇。
One store manager said locals had been discussing the news quietly. Although coverage has not been widely censored, the subject remains sensitive.
一家商店经理表示，当地人一直在私下议论这一消息。尽管相关报道尚未遭到大范围审查，但这一话题依然敏感。
In Patriotic Village No. 5, people were less cautious.
在爱国五村，人们的顾忌则少得多。
“We are all gossiping about it,” admitted a neighbor surnamed Zheng, who once made hand grenades at the factory. Another resident said many had been discussing her looks.
“大家都在议论这件事，”一位曾在厂里制造手榴弹的郑姓邻居坦言。另一位居民说，很多人一直在讨论她的长相。

In nearby Xiangtan, a man surnamed Han said he looked up to Alice Huang. Times have been tough, and it was becoming harder for local people to make money, he said. That a homegrown person could get rich was impressive.
在邻近的湘潭，一位姓韩的男子表示他很钦佩黄乐。他说，如今世道艰难，当地人赚钱越来越不容易，一个本土出身的人能够发家致富，令人印象深刻。
“I don’t care if she is the mistress of Jensen Huang,” he said. “She is great because she is a successful businesswoman.”
“我不在乎她是不是黄仁勋的情妇，”他说。“我觉得她挺厉害的，因为她是一个成功的生意人。”
艾莎(Alexandra Stevenson)、Selam Gebrekidan、 Murphy Zhao和Anjali Tsui自香港、Xinyun Wu和Pei-Lin Wu自台湾台北对本文有报道贡献。Ruoxin Zhang对本文有研究贡献。
孟建国(Paul Mozur)是时报全球科技记者，常驻台北。此前，他自香港、上海和首尔报道亚洲科技与政治的交叉议题。
Keith Bradsher是《纽约时报》北京分社社长，此前曾任上海分社社长、香港分社社长、底特律分社社长，以及华盛顿记者。他在新冠疫情期间常驻中国进行报道。
Mara Hvistendahl是国际新闻版块调查记者，可以通过电邮mara.hvistendahl@nytimes.com与她联系。
傅才德(Michael Forsythe)是《纽约时报》调查记者，常驻纽约。他此前曾驻中国，广泛报道该国各类议题。
Ana Swanson报道贸易和国际经济新闻，常驻华盛顿。她从事新闻工作已超过十年。

items.body:
DAVID PIERSON, 黄瑞黎, CECILIA KANG2026年11月25日

周一，英伟达的官方X账号发布了黄仁勋重新出任公司首席执行官的照片。 Nvidia, via Agence France-Presse — Getty Images

The reappointment of Jensen Huang as Nvidia’s chief executive appears to be good news for Beijing: The most influential advocate in the United States for selling advanced chips to China is back in charge after an extraordinary intervention by President Trump.

黄仁勋被重新任命为英伟达首席执行官，对北京来说似乎是好消息：在特朗普总统非同寻常的干预下，美国最具影响力的对华出售先进芯片的倡导者重新掌舵英伟达。

But the view in Beijing is likely to be murkier. While several Chinese tech executives welcomed Mr. Huang’s return, they also recognized that his hands may now be tied. Lawmakers in Washington are lining up to question him and tighten the rules on chip sales to China.

但北京对此事的看法可能更为复杂。尽管一些中国科技高管对黄仁勋的回归表示欢迎，他们也认识到，黄仁勋如今可能处处受到掣肘。华盛顿的议员们正纷纷准备对他展开质询，并收紧对华芯片销售规定。

Either way, the whiplash will give Beijing further impetus in its efforts to wean Chinese companies off U.S. technology and develop their own. And the latest twist in the saga of the world’s most consequential chip company and the man who built it from the ground up ensures that Nvidia will remain at the center of U.S.-China relations.

无论如何，这一反复将给北京提供进一步动力，推动中国企业摆脱对美国技术的依赖、发展自己的技术。围绕全球最具影响力的芯片企业及其一手缔造者的这场风波，如今又出现了新的转折，这意味着英伟达将继续处于美中关系的焦点。

No company can compete with Nvidia when it comes to designing advanced chips for artificial intelligence, a huge advantage for Washington as it presses to keep ahead of Beijing in the transformative technology.

在先进人工智能芯片的设计方面，没有任何企业能与英伟达匹敌，而华盛顿正力求在这项具有变革意义的技术上保持对北京的领先优势。

In the broader competition with the United States, China has exceptional engineering talent, world-class A.I. models, and access to cheap power and vast land for its data centers. It has also repeatedly demonstrated an ability to do more with less.

从中美两国更广泛的竞争格局来看，中国拥有出色的工程技术人才、世界一流的人工智能模型，以及建设数据中心所需的廉价电力和广阔土地。中国也一再展现出以更少资源创造更多价值的能力。

9月，中国领导人习近平在白宫。对华鹰派人士和国家安全官员认为，美国应限制对华出口人工智能技术。

But China is demonstrably weaker in chips and is still struggling to make enough of them to satisfy domestic demand. Epoch AI, a nonprofit research organization, estimates that smuggled chips account for roughly a third of China’s A.I. computing power, though it says the true share could be considerably smaller or larger.

但中国在芯片领域明显处于劣势，仍难以生产足够的芯片来满足国内需求。非营利研究机构Epoch AI估计，走私芯片约占中国人工智能算力的三分之一，但该机构也表示，实际比例可能远低于或远高于这一估算值。

For China’s A.I. industry and A.I. models, “Huang’s return is good news given its dependence on Nvidia and the importance of American technology,” Lizzi C. Lee, a fellow focusing on the Chinese economy at the Asia Society Policy Institute, said in an email. Beijing, she added, may also see it as “reassurance that practical and commercial interests still carry the day in Washington.”

亚洲协会政策研究所中国经济研究员李其在电子邮件中说，对中国人工智能产业和人工智能模型而言，“鉴于对英伟达的依赖和美国技术的重要性，黄仁勋的回归是好消息。”她还说，北京或许也会因此感到安心，因为这表明“务实考量和商业利益在华盛顿依然能够占据上风”。

But Ms. Lee said Chinese policymakers were unlikely to stake everything on Mr. Trump’s good will, given the results of the midterm elections and his lame-duck status. “If anything,” she said, “expect the push for domestic substitution to accelerate after this episode, which already exposed the vulnerability of China’s A.I. ambition.”

但李其表示，鉴于中期选举的结果以及特朗普已成为“跛脚鸭”总统，中国的政策制定者不太可能把所有希望都寄托在特朗普的态度上。她说：“如果说有什么影响的话，这场风波已经暴露出中国人工智能发展雄心所面临的软肋，预计此后国产替代的努力将进一步加快。”

Much will depend on Washington, where a debate has been raging about how to approach Chinese access to advanced A.I. chips. That debate intensified in recent weeks after The New York Times reported that U.S. intelligence officials believed that Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman who allegedly had an extramarital affair with Mr. Huang, was an asset working for China’s spy agency.

很大程度上，事态的发展将取决于华盛顿。围绕如何处理中国获取先进人工智能芯片的问题，华盛顿一直存在激烈争论。最近几周，在《纽约时报》报道美国情报官员认为，据称与黄仁勋有婚外情的中国女商人黄乐(Alice Huang)是为中国情报机构工作的线人后，这场争论进一步升级。

China hawks and national security officials have argued that the best way to stay ahead on A.I. is to curtail exports of American technology. Mr. Huang and his supporters say it is better to lift restrictions and make China dependent on U.S. chips.

对华鹰派和国家安全官员认为，在人工智能上保持领先的最佳方式是限制美国技术出口。黄仁勋及其支持者则认为，更好的做法是取消限制，让中国依赖美国芯片。

Two key issues for Beijing are whether it will continue to receive Nvidia chips, and whether new rules blocking Chinese companies from remotely accessing chips will persist.

北京的两个关键问题是，它是否会继续获得英伟达芯片，以及阻止中国公司远程访问芯片的新规则是否会持续。

The Trump administration reversed a ban on sales of Nvidia’s H20 chip to China in 2025 and then approved the more powerful H200. Lawmakers disclosed last week that the Commerce Department had approved the sale of more than 800,000 advanced A.I. chips to Chinese companies, including some with ties to China’s military.

2025年，特朗普政府撤销了对华销售英伟达H20芯片的禁令，随后又批准了性能更强大的H200芯片的对华销售。多名议员上周披露，商务部已批准向中国企业出售80多万枚先进人工智能芯片，其中一些企业与中国军方存在关联。

Chinese companies had also exploited a loophole until recently. Unable to import Nvidia’s most advanced chips, they rented access to them through data centers in Southeast Asia and elsewhere. That was legal until last week, when the Commerce Department issued a rule clamping down on the ability of Chinese companies to access advanced Nvidia chips through data centers in third countries, and requiring licenses for chip exports to companies in Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil.

直到不久前，中国企业还一直在利用一个监管漏洞。由于无法进口英伟达最先进的芯片，它们通过东南亚及其他地区的数据中心租用这些芯片的算力。这种做法此前一直是合法的，直到上周，美国商务部发布新规，严格限制中国企业通过第三国的数据中心使用英伟达先进芯片，并要求向马来西亚、新加坡、泰国、印度尼西亚和巴西的企业出口芯片必须获得许可证。

美国商务部上周出台了一项规定，严格限制中国企业通过马来西亚等第三国的数据中心使用英伟达先进芯片。

A week after his administration unveiled those rules, though, Mr. Trump has helped restore to power their most prominent opponent.

然而，就在特朗普政府公布这些规定一周后，特朗普却帮助这些规定最具影响力的反对者重新掌权。

Mr. Trump has framed Mr. Huang’s return partly as a way of keeping him away from Beijing. “Jensen could take the next plane to China, and I guarantee you, they would give him whatever he wanted,” Mr. Trump told CNBC on Monday.

特朗普在解释黄仁勋回归的原因时表示，此举部分是为了防止他倒向北京。“黄仁勋可以马上搭乘下一班飞机去中国，我向你保证，他想要什么，他们就会给他什么，”特朗普周一对CNBC说。

In China, where Mr. Huang’s plight has generated widespread sympathy, some voices have greeted his return as vindication. Chinese officials have dismissed as “smears and slanders” the allegations of espionage.

在中国，黄仁勋的遭遇引发了广泛同情，一些舆论认为，他的回归证明了他是清白的。中国官员此前驳斥有关间谍活动的指控，称其为“污蔑抹黑”。

Ms. Huang, who has not responded to The Times’ requests for comment, was previously at the head of Megaspeed, a Singapore-based data center company that bought large quantities of Nvidia chips and is now under federal investigation over accusations that it smuggled those chips to China.

黄乐此前执掌总部位于新加坡的数据中心公司Megaspeed，该公司购买了大量英伟达芯片，目前正因将这些芯片走私到中国的指控而接受联邦调查。她未回应《纽约时报》的置评请求。

On Tuesday, Asian shares, led by tech stocks, surged on news of Mr. Huang’s return.

周二，受黄仁勋回归消息的提振，亚洲股市在科技股的带动下大幅上涨。

China’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs declined to comment on Mr. Huang. However, the Global Times, a Communist Party tabloid, suggested that his reinstatement was proof that the spy affair was a “farce” instigated by U.S. media.

中国外交部拒绝就黄仁勋发表评论。不过，中共小报《环球时报》暗示，黄仁勋复职证明，这起间谍风波是美国媒体一手挑起的一场“闹剧”。

On Monday, the same day Mr. Huang returned, the Commerce Department added Megaspeed to a trade blacklist. Mr. Huang is also scheduled to face questions from House investigators and to testify before the Senate next week.

周一，即黄仁勋回归同一天，商务部将Megaspeed列入贸易黑名单。黄仁勋还定于下周在众议院接受质询，并在参议院作证。

美国情报官员称，新加坡数据中心企业Megaspeed的高管黄乐是为中国情报机构效力的线人，她被认为曾与黄仁勋有婚外情。

“Jensen is returning to a new political reality for U.S. export controls, which is that there is significantly more skepticism now about having a laissez-faire approach to chip sales all over the world,” said Vivek Chilukuri, director of the Technology and National Security Program at the Center for a New American Security.

“黄仁勋回归之际，美国出口管制面临新的政治现实，即对全球芯片销售采取放任自流做法受到了更多质疑，”新美国安全中心技术与国家安全项目主任维韦克·奇卢库里说。

Experts widely believe that China is six to nine months behind the United States in A.I. development. Mr. Chilukuri said that if Washington “actually closed the loopholes in export control policy and enforced the rules that are already on the books, that lead could double.”

专家普遍认为，中国的人工智能发展落后美国六至九个月。奇卢库里表示，如果华盛顿“真正堵住出口管制政策中的漏洞，并严格执行现行规定，这一领先优势可能翻倍”。

Tighter controls will only deepen mistrust of Washington in Beijing, where the controversy has been read as further proof that the United States “is not a reliable partner,” said Wu Xinbo, an American studies scholar at Fudan University in Shanghai who advises China’s Foreign Ministry. Washington, he said, could cut off China’s supply chains at any time and on any pretext.

上海复旦大学美国问题学者、中国外交部顾问吴心伯说，更严格的管制只会加深北京对华盛顿的不信任，在北京看来，这场风波进一步证明，美国“不是一个可靠的合作伙伴”。他说，华盛顿随时都可以找个借口切断中国的供应链。

To Mr. Wu, China has been less a protagonist in the Nvidia case and more of a prop in U.S. political drama.

在吴心伯看来，在英伟达事件中，中国与其说是主角，不如说是美国政治大戏中的一个道具。

“The Jensen Huang episode reflects the intense political infighting within the United States and China is just the background music,” he said.

“黄仁勋事件反映了美国内部激烈的政治内斗，中国只是背景音乐，”他说。

Other Chinese analysts warn Washington should not underestimate Beijing’s leverage. China dominates the supply of rare earths and magnets that American factories and weapons makers rely on. Under a trade truce reached last year, Beijing suspended sweeping controls on rare earth exports. But that truce expires on Jan. 10, and its extension could become entangled with the debate over U.S. chip exports.

其他中国分析人士警告华盛顿不应低估北京的影响力。中国主导着美国工厂和武器制造商依赖的稀土和磁铁供应。根据去年达成的贸易休战，北京暂停了对稀土出口的全面管制。但该休战将于1月10日到期，是否延长协议可能会与美国芯片出口的争论纠缠在一起。

Chinese analysts also say China is too big a market for American chipmakers to give up. And new restrictions, they add, would only speed up China’s efforts to power its A.I. boom with domestic chips and software. DeepSeek, one of China’s leading A.I. companies, is developing software for chips made by Huawei Technologies, partly as a way to circumvent Nvidia’s own software.

中国分析人士还说，中国市场太大，美国芯片制造商不可能放弃。他们补充说，新的限制措施只会加快中国利用国产芯片和软件推动人工智能产业蓬勃发展的步伐。中国领先的人工智能企业之一DeepSeek正在为华为生产的芯片开发软件，部分目的是为了绕过英伟达自己的软件。

But China’s government and its A.I. companies do not always have the same incentives, said Olivia Shen, director of the strategic technologies program with the United States Studies Centre at the University of Sydney. While Beijing wants its industry to use Chinese-made chips, publicly listed companies like MiniMax and Z.ai want to make globally competitive models, which — for now — can only be trained with Nvidia chips, she said.

但悉尼大学美国研究中心战略技术项目主任奥利维娅·沈表示，中国政府与本国人工智能企业的利益诉求并不总是一致。她说，北京希望本国人工智能产业使用国产芯片，稀宇科技和智谱等上市企业则希望开发具有全球竞争力的模型，而至少目前，这样的模型只能依靠英伟达芯片进行训练。

中国上市人工智能企业稀宇科技曾使用英伟达的芯片训练人工智能模型。

Still, Beijing’s ambitions will not change.

尽管如此，北京的雄心不会改变。

“Longer term, they don’t want their access to this important resource to be based on the whims of a particular character in the White House,” Ms. Shen said.

“从长远来看，他们不希望能否获得这种重要资源取决于白宫某个人的一时兴起，”奥利维娅·沈说。

David Pierson报道中国外交政策和中国与世界的经济与文化交互。他从事新闻工作已超过20年。

北京的两个关键问题是，它是否会继续获得英伟达芯片，以及阻止中国公司远程访问芯片的新规则是否会持续。

The Trump administration reversed a ban on sales of Nvidia’s H20 chip to China in 2025 and then approved the more powerful H200. Lawmakers disclosed last week that the Commerce Department had approved the sale of more than 800,000 advanced A.I. chips to Chinese companies, including some with ties to China’s military.
2025年，特朗普政府撤销了对华销售英伟达H20芯片的禁令，随后又批准了性能更强大的H200芯片的对华销售。多名议员上周披露，商务部已批准向中国企业出售80多万枚先进人工智能芯片，其中一些企业与中国军方存在关联。

Chinese companies had also exploited a loophole until recently. Unable to import Nvidia’s most advanced chips, they rented access to them through data centers in Southeast Asia and elsewhere. That was legal until last week, when the Commerce Department issued a rule clamping down on the ability of Chinese companies to access advanced Nvidia chips through data centers in third countries, and requiring licenses for chip exports to companies in Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil.
直到不久前，中国企业还一直在利用一个监管漏洞。由于无法进口英伟达最先进的芯片，它们通过东南亚及其他地区的数据中心租用这些芯片的算力。这种做法此前一直是合法的，直到上周，美国商务部发布新规，严格限制中国企业通过第三国的数据中心使用英伟达先进芯片，并要求向马来西亚、新加坡、泰国、印度尼西亚和巴西的企业出口芯片必须获得许可证。
美国商务部上周出台了一项规定，严格限制中国企业通过马来西亚等第三国的数据中心使用英伟达先进芯片。
A week after his administration unveiled those rules, though, Mr. Trump has helped restore to power their most prominent opponent.
然而，就在特朗普政府公布这些规定一周后，特朗普却帮助这些规定最具影响力的反对者重新掌权。

Mr. Trump has framed Mr. Huang’s return partly as a way of keeping him away from Beijing. “Jensen could take the next plane to China, and I guarantee you, they would give him whatever he wanted,” Mr. Trump told CNBC on Monday.
特朗普在解释黄仁勋回归的原因时表示，此举部分是为了防止他倒向北京。“黄仁勋可以马上搭乘下一班飞机去中国，我向你保证，他想要什么，他们就会给他什么，”特朗普周一对CNBC说。

In China, where Mr. Huang’s plight has generated widespread sympathy, some voices have greeted his return as vindication. Chinese officials have dismissed as “smears and slanders” the allegations of espionage.
在中国，黄仁勋的遭遇引发了广泛同情，一些舆论认为，他的回归证明了他是清白的。中国官员此前驳斥有关间谍活动的指控，称其为“污蔑抹黑”。

Ms. Huang, who has not responded to The Times’ requests for comment, was previously at the head of Megaspeed, a Singapore-based data center company that bought large quantities of Nvidia chips and is now under federal investigation over accusations that it smuggled those chips to China.
黄乐此前执掌总部位于新加坡的数据中心公司Megaspeed，该公司购买了大量英伟达芯片，目前正因将这些芯片走私到中国的指控而接受联邦调查。她未回应《纽约时报》的置评请求。
On Tuesday, Asian shares, led by tech stocks, surged on news of Mr. Huang’s return.
周二，受黄仁勋回归消息的提振，亚洲股市在科技股的带动下大幅上涨。

China’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs declined to comment on Mr. Huang. However, the Global Times, a Communist Party tabloid, suggested that his reinstatement was proof that the spy affair was a “farce” instigated by U.S. media.
中国外交部拒绝就黄仁勋发表评论。不过，中共小报《环球时报》暗示，黄仁勋复职证明，这起间谍风波是美国媒体一手挑起的一场“闹剧”。

On Monday, the same day Mr. Huang returned, the Commerce Department added Megaspeed to a trade blacklist. Mr. Huang is also scheduled to face questions from House investigators and to testify before the Senate next week.
周一，即黄仁勋回归同一天，商务部将Megaspeed列入贸易黑名单。黄仁勋还定于下周在众议院接受质询，并在参议院作证。
美国情报官员称，新加坡数据中心企业Megaspeed的高管黄乐是为中国情报机构效力的线人，她被认为曾与黄仁勋有婚外情。

“Jensen is returning to a new political reality for U.S. export controls, which is that there is significantly more skepticism now about having a laissez-faire approach to chip sales all over the world,” said Vivek Chilukuri, director of the Technology and National Security Program at the Center for a New American Security.
“黄仁勋回归之际，美国出口管制面临新的政治现实，即对全球芯片销售采取放任自流做法受到了更多质疑，”新美国安全中心技术与国家安全项目主任维韦克·奇卢库里说。

Experts widely believe that China is six to nine months behind the United States in A.I. development. Mr. Chilukuri said that if Washington “actually closed the loopholes in export control policy and enforced the rules that are already on the books, that lead could double.”
专家普遍认为，中国的人工智能发展落后美国六至九个月。奇卢库里表示，如果华盛顿“真正堵住出口管制政策中的漏洞，并严格执行现行规定，这一领先优势可能翻倍”。

Tighter controls will only deepen mistrust of Washington in Beijing, where the controversy has been read as further proof that the United States “is not a reliable partner,” said Wu Xinbo, an American studies scholar at Fudan University in Shanghai who advises China’s Foreign Ministry. Washington, he said, could cut off China’s supply chains at any time and on any pretext.
上海复旦大学美国问题学者、中国外交部顾问吴心伯说，更严格的管制只会加深北京对华盛顿的不信任，在北京看来，这场风波进一步证明，美国“不是一个可靠的合作伙伴”。他说，华盛顿随时都可以找个借口切断中国的供应链。
To Mr. Wu, China has been less a protagonist in the Nvidia case and more of a prop in U.S. political drama.
在吴心伯看来，在英伟达事件中，中国与其说是主角，不如说是美国政治大戏中的一个道具。
“The Jensen Huang episode reflects the intense political infighting within the United States and China is just the background music,” he said.
“黄仁勋事件反映了美国内部激烈的政治内斗，中国只是背景音乐，”他说。

Other Chinese analysts warn Washington should not underestimate Beijing’s leverage. China dominates the supply of rare earths and magnets that American factories and weapons makers rely on. Under a trade truce reached last year, Beijing suspended sweeping controls on rare earth exports. But that truce expires on Jan. 10, and its extension could become entangled with the debate over U.S. chip exports.
其他中国分析人士警告华盛顿不应低估北京的影响力。中国主导着美国工厂和武器制造商依赖的稀土和磁铁供应。根据去年达成的贸易休战，北京暂停了对稀土出口的全面管制。但该休战将于1月10日到期，是否延长协议可能会与美国芯片出口的争论纠缠在一起。

Chinese analysts also say China is too big a market for American chipmakers to give up. And new restrictions, they add, would only speed up China’s efforts to power its A.I. boom with domestic chips and software. DeepSeek, one of China’s leading A.I. companies, is developing software for chips made by Huawei Technologies, partly as a way to circumvent Nvidia’s own software.
中国分析人士还说，中国市场太大，美国芯片制造商不可能放弃。他们补充说，新的限制措施只会加快中国利用国产芯片和软件推动人工智能产业蓬勃发展的步伐。中国领先的人工智能企业之一DeepSeek正在为华为生产的芯片开发软件，部分目的是为了绕过英伟达自己的软件。

But China’s government and its A.I. companies do not always have the same incentives, said Olivia Shen, director of the strategic technologies program with the United States Studies Centre at the University of Sydney. While Beijing wants its industry to use Chinese-made chips, publicly listed companies like MiniMax and Z.ai want to make globally competitive models, which — for now — can only be trained with Nvidia chips, she said.
但悉尼大学美国研究中心战略技术项目主任奥利维娅·沈表示，中国政府与本国人工智能企业的利益诉求并不总是一致。她说，北京希望本国人工智能产业使用国产芯片，稀宇科技和智谱等上市企业则希望开发具有全球竞争力的模型，而至少目前，这样的模型只能依靠英伟达芯片进行训练。
中国上市人工智能企业稀宇科技曾使用英伟达的芯片训练人工智能模型。
Still, Beijing’s ambitions will not change.
尽管如此，北京的雄心不会改变。
“Longer term, they don’t want their access to this important resource to be based on the whims of a particular character in the White House,” Ms. Shen said.
“从长远来看，他们不希望能否获得这种重要资源取决于白宫某个人的一时兴起，”奥利维娅·沈说。
David Pierson报道中国外交政策和中国与世界的经济与文化交互。他从事新闻工作已超过20年。

items.body:
TRIPP MICKLE, KALLEY HUANG2026年11月25日

A day after returning as chief executive at Nvidia, Jensen Huang apologized on Tuesday to his entire company for violating its code of conduct during an hourlong meeting that began on a somber note before transforming into a defiant airing of grievances.

重返英伟达首席执行官职位一天后，黄仁勋于周二向全体员工致歉，承认自己违反了公司行为准则。这场长达一小时的会议以沉重气氛开场，随后转变为一场充满对抗情绪的诉苦会。

“I made some terrible mistakes,” he said in his first all-hands meeting with employees since his return. Referring to his wife, he added, “I was unfaithful to Lori, and I hurt my kids and, of course, hurt all of you.”

“我犯了一些可怕的错误，”他在回归后的首次全员会议上说。提到妻子时，他还说：“我对洛丽不忠，伤害了我的孩子，当然也伤害了你们所有人。”

Mr. Huang said he is in therapy every day for 90 minutes, adding that it is “not acceptable” that he violated the company’s code of conduct, some of which he wrote. He said his actions had forced the company’s board of directors to evaluate his future with the company, which led him to resign this month.

黄仁勋说，他每天接受90分钟心理治疗，并称自己违反公司行为准则——其中部分条款由他本人撰写——是“不可接受的”。他说，自己的行为迫使公司董事会评估他在公司的未来，导致他本月辞职。

The meeting cemented Mr. Huang’s return to Nvidia after two head-spinning weeks that threw the chip-making giant into turmoil, sent tech stocks into a nosedive and threatened the tech industry’s artificial intelligence boom.

在经历了令人目眩的两周后，此次会议标志着黄仁勋正式回归英伟达，此前，这起风波令这家芯片制造巨头陷入动荡，导致科技股暴跌，并威胁到科技行业的人工智能热潮。

Mr. Huang resigned after revelations that he violated the company’s code of conduct. He had an affair with a customer and Chinese citizen, Alice Huang, who U.S. government officials determined was feeding information to Chinese intelligence services. He also had a relationship with a direct report at the company. The company’s board unanimously accepted his resignation.

黄仁勋在被曝违反公司行为准则后辞职。他与客户中国公民黄乐(Alice Huang)发生婚外情，美国政府官员认定她向中国情报机构提供信息。此外，他还与公司内的一名直属下属存在亲密关系。公司董事会一致接受了他的辞职。

While Wall Street has cheered Mr. Huang’s reinstatement, there are still broad questions about his conduct, and he is expected to testify in a series of potentially contentious congressional hearings in Washington next week.

尽管华尔街对黄仁勋复职表示欢迎，但他的行为仍遭到广泛质疑，预计他下周将在华盛顿一系列可能充满争议的国会听证会上作证。

During his talk with employees, Mr. Huang sought to dismiss narratives about what had happened behind the scenes to ease his return before the board finished its own investigation into his behavior. He said he was back not because he was a “tech bro” who was “above the law” and “above the code of conduct.” Nor was he back, he said, because President Trump pressured Nvidia’s board to reinstate him.

在与员工的谈话中，黄仁勋试图驳斥有关董事会完成对他行为的调查前、幕后发生了一些事情才让他顺利回归的说法。他说，自己之所以回归，并非因为他是一个“凌驾于法律之上”和“凌驾于行为准则之上”的“科技兄弟”。他说，也不是因为特朗普总统向英伟达董事会施压要求恢复其职务。

“That is also completely untrue,” Mr. Huang said in a livestream that was reviewed by The New York Times. He was back, he said, because Nvidia’s board “evaluated the entire situation” and “gathered facts.” It also received assurances from the Trump administration that Mr. Huang was not a national security threat.

“那也完全不属实，”黄仁勋在《纽约时报》查阅的一场直播中说。他说，他之所以回归，是因为英伟达董事会“评估了整个情况”并“收集了事实”。 此外，董事会还从特朗普政府那里获得了保证，确认黄仁勋不构成国家安全威胁。

周一，纽约证券交易所交易大厅里的交易员们。

Tuesday’s meeting was the second in the past six days at Nvidia. Last Wednesday, Colette Kress, who served as interim chief executive, sought to reassure a rattled company by telling employees that Nvidia’s “ambition will not change.” She was joined onstage by more than a dozen of the company’s leaders, several of whom spoke about how they planned to move forward without Mr. Huang.

周二的会议是英伟达过去六天内的第二次会议。上周三，担任临时首席执行官的科莱特·克雷斯试图安抚动荡中的公司，告诉员工，英伟达的“雄心不会改变”。十多名公司领导人与她一同登台，其中几人谈到，在没有黄仁勋的情况下，他们计划如何推进。

Mr. Huang began Tuesday’s talk by thanking Ms. Kress and the company’s leadership team, which was seated on the front row, for doing “an incredible job.”

黄仁勋周二讲话开始时首先感谢克雷斯和坐在前排的公司领导团队“做得非常出色”。

He also praised Mr. Trump, who had encouraged the board to bring back Mr. Huang. He said Mr. Trump “really, really loves our company” and “gloats about Nvidia.”

他还赞扬特朗普，正是他鼓励董事会让黄仁勋回归。他说，特朗普“真的、真的很爱我们公司”，并且“总是得意洋洋地谈论英伟达”。

“Everything he’s done, it’s just his affection, his admiration, his recognition of the great company that you are,” Mr. Huang said.

“他所做的一切都源于他对你们所在的这个伟大公司的喜爱、钦佩和认可，”黄仁勋说。

Mr. Huang said he would be “in service of helping our president make our country successful,” but he said that did not make Nvidia a political company.

黄仁勋说，他将“致力于帮助我们的总统，让我们的国家成功”，但他表示这不会使英伟达成为一家政治化的公司。

“Not even a little bit,” he said. “We are the most apolitical company.”

“一点都不，”他说。“我们是最不政治化的公司。”

Mr. Huang told employees that he had returned to the company because Nvidia’s board had decided it was “in the best interest of the company and shareholders.”

黄仁勋告诉员工，他回到公司是因为英伟达董事会认定这“符合公司和股东的最佳利益”。

He also said the board’s decision did not mean other employees could violate the code of conduct. That would not be “appropriate” or “tolerated,” he said.

他还说，董事会的决定并不意味着其他员工可以违反行为准则。他说，那样既不“恰当”，也不会被“容忍”。

“Sometimes, it’s appropriate to forgive,” he said. “Sometimes it’s not.”

“有时候，宽恕是恰当的，”他说。“有时候不是。”

Mr. Huang addressed a report by The Times about his management style, which he had described in the past as “torture you into greatness.” For years, he berated employees with insults, personal attacks and violent comments.

黄仁勋回应了《纽约时报》关于他管理风格的报道。他过去曾将这种风格描述为“通过折磨让你变得伟大”。多年来，他用侮辱、人身攻击和暴力言论斥责员工。

上周，英伟达总部外的员工们。

“I can go too far,” Mr. Huang said. “When I go too far, it hurts people, it belittles them, it disempowers them. And that’s not right.”

“我可能做得过分，”黄仁勋说。“当我做得过分时，会伤害他人，贬低他们，剥夺他们的力量。那是不对的。”

Mr. Huang said Nvidia’s human resources department would collect feedback about him and share it monthly with the board of directors. He said he wanted to make sure he was “able to channel my intensity in the service of making our company better.”

黄仁勋说，英伟达人力资源部门将收集关于他的反馈，并每月与董事会分享。他说，他想确保自己“能够将我的激情转化为推动公司进步的力量”。

He also attacked criticism of the company’s organizational structure, in which he had more than 60 direct reports, while boasting that he doesn’t “believe in succession planning” because it would imply some executives were more important than others.

他还抨击了对公司组织结构的批评，该架构下他拥有超过60名直接下属，同时他还夸耀自己“不相信继任计划”，因为这会暗示某些高管比其他高管更重要。

In his defense of Nvidia’s unusual management structure, Mr. Huang said it was “his pride and joy.” He credited it with allowing the company to move fast, innovate often and continue operating in his absence.

在为英伟达不寻常的管理架构辩护时，黄仁勋说这是“他的骄傲和喜悦”。 他认为正是这种架构使公司能够快速行动、频繁创新，并在自己缺席时仍能正常运转。

“This company is wired up to execute and execute and execute and deliver on financial results,” he said. He said any of the company’s top 60 executives could succeed him.

“这家公司被设定为执行、执行、再执行，并且最终实现财务业绩，”他说。他说，公司前60名高管中的任何一位都可以接替他。

“That is the definition of an extraordinary organization, not an example of brittleness,” he said. “I will fight that all day long.”

“这正是卓越组织的定义，而不是脆弱的例证，”他说。“我会为此奋战到底。”

Tripp Mickle报道英伟达、谷歌和苹果等全球最大的科技公司。他也报道整个科技行业的趋势，包括裁员、生成式AI和机器人出租车等。

Kalley Huang是时报驻旧金山记者，报道科技行业和业内大型公司，包括英伟达和苹果。

翻译：纽约时报中文网

在经历了令人目眩的两周后，此次会议标志着黄仁勋正式回归英伟达，此前，这起风波令这家芯片制造巨头陷入动荡，导致科技股暴跌，并威胁到科技行业的人工智能热潮。

Mr. Huang resigned after revelations that he violated the company’s code of conduct. He had an affair with a customer and Chinese citizen, Alice Huang, who U.S. government officials determined was feeding information to Chinese intelligence services. He also had a relationship with a direct report at the company. The company’s board unanimously accepted his resignation.
黄仁勋在被曝违反公司行为准则后辞职。他与客户中国公民黄乐(Alice Huang)发生婚外情，美国政府官员认定她向中国情报机构提供信息。此外，他还与公司内的一名直属下属存在亲密关系。公司董事会一致接受了他的辞职。

While Wall Street has cheered Mr. Huang’s reinstatement, there are still broad questions about his conduct, and he is expected to testify in a series of potentially contentious congressional hearings in Washington next week.
尽管华尔街对黄仁勋复职表示欢迎，但他的行为仍遭到广泛质疑，预计他下周将在华盛顿一系列可能充满争议的国会听证会上作证。

During his talk with employees, Mr. Huang sought to dismiss narratives about what had happened behind the scenes to ease his return before the board finished its own investigation into his behavior. He said he was back not because he was a “tech bro” who was “above the law” and “above the code of conduct.” Nor was he back, he said, because President Trump pressured Nvidia’s board to reinstate him.
在与员工的谈话中，黄仁勋试图驳斥有关董事会完成对他行为的调查前、幕后发生了一些事情才让他顺利回归的说法。他说，自己之所以回归，并非因为他是一个“凌驾于法律之上”和“凌驾于行为准则之上”的“科技兄弟”。他说，也不是因为特朗普总统向英伟达董事会施压要求恢复其职务。

“That is also completely untrue,” Mr. Huang said in a livestream that was reviewed by The New York Times. He was back, he said, because Nvidia’s board “evaluated the entire situation” and “gathered facts.” It also received assurances from the Trump administration that Mr. Huang was not a national security threat.
“那也完全不属实，”黄仁勋在《纽约时报》查阅的一场直播中说。他说，他之所以回归，是因为英伟达董事会“评估了整个情况”并“收集了事实”。 此外，董事会还从特朗普政府那里获得了保证，确认黄仁勋不构成国家安全威胁。
周一，纽约证券交易所交易大厅里的交易员们。

Tuesday’s meeting was the second in the past six days at Nvidia. Last Wednesday, Colette Kress, who served as interim chief executive, sought to reassure a rattled company by telling employees that Nvidia’s “ambition will not change.” She was joined onstage by more than a dozen of the company’s leaders, several of whom spoke about how they planned to move forward without Mr. Huang.
周二的会议是英伟达过去六天内的第二次会议。上周三，担任临时首席执行官的科莱特·克雷斯试图安抚动荡中的公司，告诉员工，英伟达的“雄心不会改变”。十多名公司领导人与她一同登台，其中几人谈到，在没有黄仁勋的情况下，他们计划如何推进。
Mr. Huang began Tuesday’s talk by thanking Ms. Kress and the company’s leadership team, which was seated on the front row, for doing “an incredible job.”
黄仁勋周二讲话开始时首先感谢克雷斯和坐在前排的公司领导团队“做得非常出色”。
He also praised Mr. Trump, who had encouraged the board to bring back Mr. Huang. He said Mr. Trump “really, really loves our company” and “gloats about Nvidia.”
他还赞扬特朗普，正是他鼓励董事会让黄仁勋回归。他说，特朗普“真的、真的很爱我们公司”，并且“总是得意洋洋地谈论英伟达”。
“Everything he’s done, it’s just his affection, his admiration, his recognition of the great company that you are,” Mr. Huang said.
“他所做的一切都源于他对你们所在的这个伟大公司的喜爱、钦佩和认可，”黄仁勋说。
Mr. Huang said he would be “in service of helping our president make our country successful,” but he said that did not make Nvidia a political company.
黄仁勋说，他将“致力于帮助我们的总统，让我们的国家成功”，但他表示这不会使英伟达成为一家政治化的公司。
“Not even a little bit,” he said. “We are the most apolitical company.”
“一点都不，”他说。“我们是最不政治化的公司。”
Mr. Huang told employees that he had returned to the company because Nvidia’s board had decided it was “in the best interest of the company and shareholders.”

He also said the board’s decision did not mean other employees could violate the code of conduct. That would not be “appropriate” or “tolerated,” he said.
他还说，董事会的决定并不意味着其他员工可以违反行为准则。他说，那样既不“恰当”，也不会被“容忍”。
“Sometimes, it’s appropriate to forgive,” he said. “Sometimes it’s not.”
“有时候，宽恕是恰当的，”他说。“有时候不是。”

Mr. Huang addressed a report by The Times about his management style, which he had described in the past as “torture you into greatness.” For years, he berated employees with insults, personal attacks and violent comments.
黄仁勋回应了《纽约时报》关于他管理风格的报道。他过去曾将这种风格描述为“通过折磨让你变得伟大”。多年来，他用侮辱、人身攻击和暴力言论斥责员工。

“I can go too far,” Mr. Huang said. “When I go too far, it hurts people, it belittles them, it disempowers them. And that’s not right.”
“我可能做得过分，”黄仁勋说。“当我做得过分时，会伤害他人，贬低他们，剥夺他们的力量。那是不对的。”

Mr. Huang said Nvidia’s human resources department would collect feedback about him and share it monthly with the board of directors. He said he wanted to make sure he was “able to channel my intensity in the service of making our company better.”

He also attacked criticism of the company’s organizational structure, in which he had more than 60 direct reports, while boasting that he doesn’t “believe in succession planning” because it would imply some executives were more important than others.
他还抨击了对公司组织结构的批评，该架构下他拥有超过60名直接下属，同时他还夸耀自己“不相信继任计划”，因为这会暗示某些高管比其他高管更重要。

“That is the definition of an extraordinary organization, not an example of brittleness,” he said. “I will fight that all day long.”

items.summary: 这名 31 岁的越南男子因未能完成在日本的学业而离家出走。 他的亲戚曾借钱并花光几乎所有积蓄供他求学。由于觉得无颜面对家人，他一直没有回家。 后来，有人在一个建筑工地发现了他。他当时一直躲在大型混凝土排水管里。 警方将他带到警察局，之后他与家人团聚。
items.body:
一名越南男子在排水管道中生活七年后被发现

这名 31 岁的越南男子因未能完成在日本的学业而离家出走。

他的亲戚曾借钱并花光几乎所有积蓄供他求学。由于觉得无颜面对家人，他一直没有回家。

后来，有人在一个建筑工地发现了他。他当时一直躲在大型混凝土排水管里。

警方将他带到警察局，之后他与家人团聚。

items.body:
储百亮2026年11月25日

上海市委书记陈吉宁。他的科学教育背景被认为与中国最高领导人习近平的优先事项相契合。 Pool photo by Carl Court

The Communist Party leader of Shanghai, Chen Jining, has been placed under investigation on suspicion of “serious violations,” the Chinese government announced on Tuesday. It was a stunning downfall for an official who had widely been seen as destined for a higher role under the country’s top leader, Xi Jinping.

中国政府周二宣布，上海市委书记陈吉宁因涉嫌“严重违纪违法”正接受调查。作为一位普遍被视为将在中国最高领导人习近平治下晋升更高职位的官员，他的落马令人震惊。

The investigation into Mr. Chen was announced in a brief bulletin from Xinhua, China’s official news agency, which gave no details about reasons. The bulletin said that Mr. Chen was suspected of “serious violations of discipline and the law,” a phrase that usually refers to allegations of corruption.

对陈吉宁的调查是通过中国官方通讯社新华社的一则简短通报宣布的，通报未给出具体原因。通报称，陈吉宁涉嫌“严重违纪违法”，这一表述通常指涉腐败指控。

Mr. Chen, 62, an environmental scientist trained in Britain, rose as a university president and minister for environmental protection. He went on to become mayor of Beijing and, from 2022, party secretary of Shanghai — a key post in charge of one of China’s most important commercial cities that often opens the way to central leadership.

现年62岁的陈吉宁是一名曾在英国深造的环境科学家，历任大学校长和环保部部长。此后他出任北京市市长，并于2022年起担任上海市委书记——这一关键职位掌管着中国最重要的商业城市之一，往往意味着仕途将通往中央领导层。

His abrupt treatment suggests that Mr. Xi’s expanding drive against corruption and disloyalty means that even seemingly secure protégés cannot feel safe as Mr. Xi prepares to claim an all-but-certain fourth term ruling China. Other officials made subject to investigations have gone on to face prosecution, conviction and imprisonment.

对他的突然处置表明，随着习近平准备开启几乎毫无悬念的第四个执政任期，在其不断扩大的反腐与整肃不忠行动之下，即便是看似稳固的亲信也无法高枕无忧。以往接受调查的官员随后会面临起诉、定罪和监禁。

One month ago, Mr. Xi presided over a meeting of the Communist Party Central Committee where he called for a renewed campaign for discipline and loyalty. The meeting also announced preparations for a party congress next year, at which Mr. Xi is almost certain to win another five years as general secretary.

一个月前，习近平主持召开了一次中共中央委员会会议，他在会上呼吁开展新一轮纪律和忠诚整顿行动。会议还宣布筹备明年的党代会，习近平几乎肯定将在会上再次获得五年的总书记任期。

Many analysts thought that Mr. Chen could rise to become premier, or at least a vice premier, in Mr. Xi’s next administration. Mr. Chen had won a reputation as a technocrat whose scientific education blended well with Mr. Xi’s technological priorities.

许多分析人士曾认为，陈吉宁有望在习近平的下一届政府中晋升为总理，或至少担任副总理。陈吉宁一直被视为技术官僚，其科学教育背景与习近平的科技优先事项十分契合。

Mr. Chen is also a member of the party’s Politburo, a council of leading central and local officials. He is now virtually certain to be expelled from the party and from the Politburo, which would mean that four of the 24 Politburo members elected in 2022 had been removed and investigated. One of those was Zhang Youxia, China’s topmost general until his removal this year.

陈吉宁同时也是中共中央政治局委员，该机构由中央和地方主要领导官员组成。如今他几乎肯定将被开除党籍并被免去政治局委员职务，这意味着2022年选出的24名政治局委员中，已有四人被免职和接受调查。其中包括今年被免职前一直是中国军队最高将领的张又侠。

This month, Mr. Chen convened a meeting in Shanghai where he warned officials to abide by Mr. Xi’s warnings against corruption and other abuses of power.

本月，陈吉宁在上海主持召开了一次会议，他在会上告诫官员要遵守习近平关于反腐败及其他滥用权力行为的警示。

“Elevate your political stance, and remain clearheaded and vigilant,” Mr. Chen told them.

“提高政治站位，保持清醒警醒，”陈吉宁对他们说。

储百亮(Chris Buckley)是《纽约时报》首席中国记者，自台北报道中国和台湾问题，重点关注政治、社会变革以及安全和军事问题。

items.body:
日方事先知晓专机与深圳机场舷梯间高度差较大

关于日本首相高市早苗18日为出席亚太经合组织（APEC）首脑会议抵达中国深圳机场时，政府专机与舷梯之间的高度差较大一事，官房长官木原稔在24日的记者会上透露称，日方在现场就发现了该情况，并敦促高市一行下机时需要注意。木原说：“我们在现场就确认到出现了一定的高度差，在临近下机前告知了机内人员。”

　　高市当时一边注意脚下，一边小心翼翼地从专机走下了舷梯。以网络为中心，出现了认为“这或许是中方的冷遇”的意见。

　　自民党在外交小组与外交调查会的联席会议上，倾听了政府方面对此事原委的说明。据与会议员透露，政府方面说明称，驻华大使金杉宪治告诉机内高度差较大，首相身边人员在机上讨论了应对方案，最终判断认为只要加以注意就可以安全下机。

　　自民党代理干事长萩生田光一在记者会上就此表示，“我觉得中方并非有意无礼，而是事发突然”，然后强调“作为东道主国家，应当如何做好准备？希望中方自行思考并反省”。

日外相称不会以观察员身份参加禁核条约审议大会

日本外相茂木敏充在24日的记者会上表示，日本不会以观察员身份参加30日起在美国纽约联合国总部召开的《禁止核武器条约》首次审议大会。他提到日本周边安全保障环境严峻，并主张称：“如果参加，可能会就日本的核威慑政策发出错误讯息，妨碍和平与安全的保障。”

　　禁核条约是首部全面禁止核武器的国际条约，于2021年生效。拥核国家并未加入。处于美国“核保护伞”之下的日本也未以观察员身份参加。

　　考虑到中国和朝鲜，茂木还在记者会上指出，日本周边包括核与导弹在内的军备扩张正在迅速推进。他表示：“为了守护日本的和平，依靠核武器的延伸威慑不可或缺。条约与日本的核威慑政策并不相容。”

塔吉克斯坦宣布将退出ICC

据联合国消息，中亚国家塔吉克斯坦11月20日向联合国发出通知称，将于一年后的2027年11月20日正式退出国际刑事法院（ICC）。

塔吉克斯坦曾是前苏联加盟共和国，俄罗斯将之视为自己的势力范围。国际刑事法院围绕乌克兰局势对俄罗斯总统普京发出了逮捕令，但塔吉克斯坦在普京去年10月到访时并未将其逮捕，因此国际刑事法院指出，塔吉克斯坦未能履行其合作义务。

进入今年以来，已有6个国家向联合国发出通知，宣布退出国际刑事法院。鉴于美国总统特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统普京11月19日在中国举行三国元首会晤时一致表示，国际刑事法院以及其他类似机构不得滥用管辖权，这也引发了对更多国家退出国际刑事法院的担忧。

关于塔吉克斯坦宣布退出一事，国际刑事法院在接受NHK的采访时表示：“我们对于退出旨在惩治最严重国际犯罪行动的任何决定都深感遗憾。”

黄仁勋向特朗普作出承诺

英伟达公司11月23日宣布，重新任命黄仁勋为英伟达公司总裁、首席执行官、董事。官网更新了黄仁勋简历，已改为“创始人、总裁兼首席执行官”。

美国总统特朗普当地时间23日在接受美国消费者新闻与商业频道近1小时专访时说：“我昨晚和他通了电话，我跟他说：黄仁勋，答应我一件事，好好干。”

“这件事之所以发酵到这么大，说到底，桃色新闻自带流量。”特朗普说，黄仁勋的家人已经选择接纳，所有人都会慢慢接纳。“他（黄仁勋）有一个很棒的妻子和孩子。我不认识他的孩子，但我认识他的妻子。她是一位了不起的女性，一直非常支持他。 ”

“我昨晚和他通了电话，我跟他说：黄仁勋，答应我一件事，好好干。你拥有无与伦比的头脑，只要全力以赴，没有人能追上你。他向我承诺，会比以往更加努力。他情绪高涨，他人很好，这段日子承受了巨大压力。”特朗普说，与黄仁勋的电话只托付了一件事：好好干。“其余的我没有多谈，他比我们所有人都清楚利弊，知道什么该改、什么该坚守。”

据中国新闻网消息，黄仁勋复职后，纽约州民主党参议员、参议院少数党领袖查克·舒默在社交媒体上表示，民主党将在2027年掌控国会后，“动用全部权力”调查特朗普政府、黄仁勋、其他英伟达高管以及任何为经济利益“出卖国家安全”的人的不当行为。

英伟达股价23日盘中最高一度触及171.50美元，随后自高点回落，最终收于165.05美元，涨幅达31.48%。

空头数据分析机构ORTEX的估算显示，当地时间23日，英伟达卖空者面临约122亿美元（约人民币812亿元）浮亏，为2019年以来最大单日浮亏。按每股168.50美元的参考基准价格测算，这笔浮亏抵消了空头上周约105亿美元浮盈。

村上春树在京都演讲 悼念“村上双杰”之一村上龙

日本著名作家村上春树（77岁）21日在京都市的同志社大学发表演讲，谈及10月去世的作家村上龙（74岁）称：“我和龙是同一代人，持续笔耕约半个世纪。我们共享一个时代，在某种意义上也可以说是并肩前行。他是一位难得的作家，也是难得的人物。”

　　两人在上世纪八十年代一同风靡日本文坛，被称为“村上双杰”。村上春树称，他读了村上龙1980年出版的小说《寄物柜婴儿》后受到激励，决心“必须写出这样有力量的小说”。他还谈及两人的一段往事，村上春树说自己写作时抱着只要10个人中有1到2个人喜欢就好的心态，而村上龙说“如果没有10个人都说好，我就会生气”。村上春树悼念故人：“他的存在给了我很好的刺激，也是珍贵的鼓励。他的离开让我感到非常寂寞，也很遗憾。”

　　村上春树在自己出生的京都市演讲，以“故事所揭示的意义”为题，阐述了对人类而言故事的起源及意义。他指出，社交平台（SNS）上真假难辨的信息泛滥，呈现出“在封闭社群中推动人们朝特定方向行动”的倾向。他强调，要对抗引发人们不良共鸣的“坏故事”，唯有讲述力量更胜一筹的“好故事”。

items.body:
MICHELLE GOLDBERG2026年11月24日

Jensen Huang, the Nvidia chief executive ousted amid a spying scandal and then shockingly reinstated on Monday, has given new meaning to the phrase too big to fail.

英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在间谍丑闻中下台、又在周一令人震惊地复职，他为“大而不能倒”这一说法赋予了新的含义。

In recent days, there has been a cascade of revelations about the scale of the national security breach Huang created with his affair with Alice Huang, the businesswoman who U.S. intelligence agencies believe is a Chinese spy. Nvidia dominates the production of advanced A.I. chips, and The New York Times reported that China’s chief spy agency made acquiring such chips a priority. The Times found that Alice Huang was part of a network that funneled chips to China’s military. While she was sleeping with Jensen, she was in contact with an officer from China’s Ministry of State Security.

关于黄仁勋因与女商人黄乐(Alice Huang)——美国情报机构认为她是中国间谍——的婚外情所造成国家安全漏洞之严重，近日不断有新的披露。英伟达主导着先进人工智能芯片的生产，《纽约时报》报道称，中国主要情报机构已将获取此类芯片列为优先事项。时报发现，黄乐属于一个向中国军方输送芯片的网络。在与黄仁勋保持亲密关系期间，她一直与中国国家安全部的一名官员保持联系。

All this suggests that Jensen Huang was somehow involved, inadvertently or otherwise, in a Chinese plot to evade American restrictions on the sophisticated chips at the heart of the A.I. boom, which China has not figured out how to manufacture itself. As the contours of this scandal were coming into focus, Americans have been getting a visceral sense of the way their lives can be upended by advanced A.I. systems, especially if they fall into the wrong hands. Over the past two weeks, airplanes were grounded, banking was disrupted, many people couldn’t use their email, and an internal communications network at the National Security Agency went down. Most of these outages seem to be the result of A.I. agents revealing security vulnerabilities that needed to be hurriedly patched. But while they were not, at least as far as we know, caused by cyberattacks, they still demonstrated how easily a malign actor could use A.I. to destabilize our society.

这一切表明，黄仁勋在某种程度上——无论是有意还是无意——卷入了中国规避美国先进芯片限制的图谋。这些精密芯片是人工智能热潮的核心，而中国尚未掌握自主制造技术。随着这起丑闻的轮廓逐渐清晰，美国人正切身感受到先进人工智能系统可能如何颠覆他们的生活，尤其是在落入不法分子之手的情况下。过去两周，飞机停飞、银行业务中断、许多人无法使用电子邮件，国家安全局的一个内部通信网络也陷入瘫痪。这些故障大多似乎是由于AI智能体暴露了需要紧急修补的安全漏洞所致。但尽管这些事件并非由网络攻击引起——至少据我们目前所知是如此，它们仍表明恶意行为者利用人工智能破坏我们社会的稳定有多么容易。

We don’t yet know the impact of Jensen Huang’s Chinese entanglement on American national security, but he may have caused lasting damage. His removal from Nvidia, however, harmed something Donald Trump values even more: the stock market.

我们尚不清楚黄仁勋与中国的关联对美国国家安全产生了何种影响，但他可能已经造成了持久的损害。然而，他被英伟达解职，却损害了唐纳德·特朗普更加看重的东西：股市。

On Friday, Nvidia’s share price plunged, as did the stocks of many companies tied to the A.I. industry. It seemed for a moment as if the indiscretions of a single middle-aged man might pop the A.I. bubble that has been keeping America’s economy aloft.

周五，英伟达股价暴跌，许多与人工智能行业相关的公司股票也随之大跌。一时间，似乎一名中年男子的不检点行为就可能刺破一直支撑着美国经济的人工智能泡沫。

It’s not just that Huang made himself irreplaceable within his multitrillion-dollar company. He also put Nvidia at the center of a series of circular financing agreements propping up the whole A.I. industry. Nvidia provides hundreds of billions in loan guarantees for companies building data centers, which in turn use Nvidia chips. As The Times has reported, so great are Nvidia’s loan commitments and financing arrangements that if it were a bank, it would be the 10th-largest in the country. Huang made it extremely expensive for anyone to hold him accountable.

黄仁勋不仅在自己这家市值数万亿美元的公司中变得不可或缺，还将英伟达置于一系列支撑整个人工智能行业的循环融资协议的中心。英伟达为建设数据中心的公司提供数千亿美元的贷款担保，而这些公司反过来又使用英伟达的芯片。正如时报所报道，英伟达的贷款承诺和融资安排规模如此庞大，如果它是一家银行，将成为美国第十大银行。黄仁勋让所有人难以承担追究他责任的代价。

So Trump, never a fan of rich men facing consequences, launched a rescue mission. According to The Times, he dispatched JD Vance to help broker Huang’s restoration, including by offering Nvidia’s board assurances that Huang doesn’t pose a national security risk. There’s no way to know what intelligence this assessment was based on. It seems somewhat contradicted by Trump’s suggestion on CNBC that if Huang didn’t get his job back, he might decide he’s “angry at our country” and decamp to China.

于是，向来不愿看到富人承担后果的特朗普发起了一场营救行动。据时报报道，他派出JD·万斯协助斡旋黄仁勋复职，包括向英伟达董事会保证黄仁勋不构成国家安全风险。我们无从得知这一评估基于何种情报。这似乎与特朗普在CNBC上的暗示有些矛盾——他称如果拿不回工作，黄仁勋可能会“对我们国家感到愤怒”，进而出走中国。

Trump has now yoked the rest of his presidency, as well as Vance’s political future, to Jensen Huang. We will likely spend the next two years learning more about how China benefited from smuggled Nvidia chips, and whether Jensen Huang enabled that smuggling.

特朗普如今已将他剩余的总统任期以及万斯的政治前途与黄仁勋捆绑在一起。我们很可能会在未来两年里了解到更多有关中国如何从走私的英伟达芯片中获益，以及黄仁勋是否促成了这种走私的信息。

However this scandal develops, Trump has demonstrated that his administration’s culture of impunity, as well as his alliance with tech oligarchs, remains intact despite the repudiation of the midterms. (Under Huang, Nvidia donated $1 million to Trump’s inaugural fund and at least $20 million to his ballroom, and the C.E.O. certainly seems to have gotten his money’s worth.) One thing that has changed since Nov. 3, however, is the Republican incentive to look the other way.

无论这起丑闻如何发展，特朗普都已经表明，尽管在中期选举中遭到选民否决，其政府有罪不罚的文化以及他与科技寡头的联盟依然完好无损。（在黄仁勋领导下，英伟达向特朗普的就职基金捐赠了100万美元，并向他的宴会厅捐赠了至少2000万美元，看起来这位首席执行官的钱确实花得很值。）不过，自11月3日以来，有一件事发生了变化，那就是共和党人对此视而不见的动机。

After all, much of the party’s base is hawkish on China and suspicious of Big Tech. Now Trump has all but declared that tech stock prices matter more than Chinese espionage. The Nvidia affair is thus an opportunity for Republicans ready to distance themselves from their unpopular, lame-duck president. Senator Rick Scott of Florida told reporters, “This looks terrible on its face.” On X, Kevin Cramer, a Republican senator from North Dakota, wrote that while Nvidia’s board has assumed the risk of hiring a chief executive “who may very well be convicted in the United States or other nations of violating espionage and export control laws,” the “national security risk is passed along to the United States military and its citizens.”

毕竟，该党的大部分基本盘对华持鹰派立场，且对大型科技公司心存疑虑。如今特朗普几乎等于宣称，科技股价格比中国间谍活动更重要。因此，英伟达事件为准备与这位不受欢迎的跛脚鸭总统拉开距离的共和党人提供了机会。佛罗里达州参议员里克·斯科特对记者表示：“这件事看上去非常糟糕。”北达科他州共和党参议员凯文·克莱默在X上写道，英伟达董事会承担了聘用一位“很可能在美国或其他国家因违反间谍法和出口管制法而被定罪”的首席执行官的风险，而“国家安全风险将传导到美国军方和国民身上”。

For a certain subset of citizens, that risk is more than worth it. Nvidia’s stock price shot up 33 percent after Huang’s return. Trump has probably benefited personally; as of the end of last year, he owned Nvidia shares worth $12 million. Cantor Fitzgerald, the investment banking company once run by Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and now operated by his sons, put out a Monday research note on Nvidia headlined, “All is Right in the World Again (and a Very Happy Day).” For those with the right investments, it certainly was.

对一部分国民而言，这种风险完全值得。黄仁勋回归后，英伟达股价飙升了33%。特朗普本人可能也从中受益；截至去年年底，他持有价值1200万美元的英伟达股票。曾由商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克执掌、现由其儿子们经营的投资银行坎托菲茨杰拉德周一发布了一份关于英伟达的研究报告，标题为《世界重新恢复正常（这是非常开心的一天）》。对那些押对宝的投资人来说，确实如此。

Michelle Goldberg自2017年起担任时报专栏作者。她著有多本关于政治、宗教和女性权利的书籍，也是2018年因报道工作场所性骚扰问题而获得普利策公共服务奖的团队成员之一。

items.body:
PETER BAKER2026年11月24日

By his own account, President Trump was watching the stock market slide and decided to stop it. He would take it upon himself to determine who should lead one of the nation’s largest companies. Never mind national security concerns, never mind the autonomy of the private sector. Mr. Trump would decide.

据特朗普总统自己说，他当时看着股市下跌，决定出手阻止。他要亲自决定谁应该领导这个国家最大的公司之一。不管国家安全关切，也不管私营部门的自主权。特朗普要自己决定。

The president’s extraordinary intervention resulted in Jensen Huang’s reinstatement as chief executive of Nvidia on Monday, just 11 days after he was forced out amid a Chinese espionage scandal. Mr. Trump then got the result he sought. Sagging stock markets shot back up, restoring nearly $1 trillion in value alone to investors of Nvidia, who happen to include himself.

罗德岛州民主党参议员杰克·里德是参议院银行委员会成员，该委员会定于12月3日听取黄仁勋作证。他说，国会应审查特朗普与黄仁勋及英伟达董事会成员的沟通，以确定特朗普向他们保证或承诺了什么。

The economy, he added, depends on rule of law and fair dealing. “President Trump’s improper interventions damage these principles and must be investigated.”

The image appeared to be an A.I. composite based on the famous photo of Mr. Trump after he survived an attempted assassination at a 2024 rally in Butler, Pa., surrounded by Secret Service agents, blood on his face, pumping his fist in the air. In the version that the president shared online, Mr. Huang was at the center of the frame, with blood on his face, holding up a red bra. Behind him waved a flag that said “Nvidia.”

这张图片似乎是一张人工智能合成图，基于2024年特朗普在宾夕法尼亚州巴特勒一场集会上遭暗杀未遂后生还的著名照片：他被特勤局特工包围，脸上有血，挥拳向空中。在总统分享的版本中，黄仁勋位于画面中央，脸上有血，举着一件红色胸罩。他身后飘扬着一面写着“英伟达”字样的旗帜。

The surreal post seemed to sum up Mr. Trump’s often flippant, from-the-gut, anything-goes approach to the presidency, in which his whims become official policy. With the image, he managed to mock both the seriousness of political violence and a major espionage operation all at once — flicking both off with a reference to women’s undergarments, as if it were a sexual conquest.

这条超现实的帖子似乎概括了特朗普在总统任期内往往轻率、凭直觉、无所顾忌的行事方式——他的突发奇想往往直接成为官方政策。通过这张图片，他设法同时嘲弄了政治暴力的严重性和一场重大间谍行动——用一件女性内衣将二者轻轻带过，仿佛这只是一场性征服。

“每次有一个长得好看或漂亮的中国女人，他们就说她是间谍，”他对CNBC说。但他还说，“就黄仁勋而言，我不相信那是真的。”

Putin of Russia in 2018, when the U.S. president took the word of his Russian counterpart over that of his own intelligence agencies about Moscow’s meddling in the U.S. election in 2016.

Mr. Trump has demonstrated a habit of helping out those he knows personally, particularly with pardons. 特朗普一直表现出帮助自己熟人的习惯，尤其是在赦免方面。虽然他为黄仁勋所做的事本身并非正式赦免，但相当于总统赦免，因为他向英伟达董事会保证，可以恢复黄仁勋的高管职位，无需担心被起诉。

“The United States Government has no reason to believe that Jensen’s return to NVIDIA poses any risk to National Security,” Mr. Trump wrote on social media on Monday. Based on what the government told it, the board said in its own statement that it is “confident that Mr. Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk.”

“美国政府没有理由认为黄仁勋重返英伟达会对国家安全构成任何风险，”特朗普周一在社交媒体上写道。根据政府提供的内容，董事会在其声明中表示，它“确信黄仁勋复职不会构成国家安全风险”。

The president has had a tendency to sympathize with and defend powerful men accused of sexual wrongdoing — at least those politically aligned with him. Mr. Trump himself has been found liable in civil court for sexually abusing and defaming the writer E. Jean Carroll and ordered to pay her about $90 million; he has been accused by many others of inappropriate sexual conduct as well, although he has repeatedly denied the allegations.

总统倾向于同情并捍卫被指控性行为不当的有权势男性——至少是那些在政治上与他一致的人。特朗普本人已被民事法庭认定对性虐待和诽谤作家E·简·卡罗尔负有责任，并被命令向她支付约9000万美元；他还被许多人指控有不当性行为，尽管他一再否认这些指控。

Mr. Huang, in this view, is a victim, not a villain. “We have to take care of our geniuses, by the way,” Mr. Trump told Fox while in China. “We don’t have that many of them. When we have brilliant people like Jensen, we can’t say, ‘Oh, you know, he did this or he did —’ We have to take care.”

从这一角度看，黄仁勋是受害者，不是反派。“顺便说一句，我们必须照顾我们的天才，”特朗普在中国访问期间对福克斯说。“我们没有那么多天才。当我们有黄仁勋这样杰出的人时，我们不能说，‘哦，你知道，他做了这个或他做了那个——’我们必须照顾他们。”

Peter Baker是《纽约时报》首席白宫记者。特朗普是他报道的第六任美国总统，有时他也撰写将总统和美国政府置于更宏观的背景和历史框架下的分析性文章。
