仿佛特朗普的行为还不够离奇，他公开庆祝自己成功施压更加剧了舆论风波。英伟达恢复黄仁勋职务后不久，特朗普在社交媒体上发布了一张怪异图片，把这位再次上任的公司首席执行官描绘成殉道者。

The image appeared to be an A.I. composite based on the famous photo of Mr. Trump after he survived an attempted assassination at a 2024 rally in Butler, Pa., surrounded by Secret Service agents, blood on his face, pumping his fist in the air. In the version that the president shared online, Mr. Huang was at the center of the frame, with blood on his face, holding up a red bra. Behind him waved a flag that said “Nvidia.”
这张图片似乎是一张人工智能合成图，基于2024年特朗普在宾夕法尼亚州巴特勒一场集会上遭暗杀未遂后生还的著名照片：他被特勤局特工包围，脸上有血，挥拳向空中。在总统分享的版本中，黄仁勋位于画面中央，脸上有血，举着一件红色胸罩。他身后飘扬着一面写着“英伟达”字样的旗帜。

The surreal post seemed to sum up Mr. Trump’s often flippant, from-the-gut, anything-goes approach to the presidency, in which his whims become official policy. With the image, he managed to mock both the seriousness of political violence and a major espionage operation all at once — flicking both off with a reference to women’s undergarments, as if it were a sexual conquest.
这条超现实的帖子似乎概括了特朗普在总统任期内往往轻率、凭直觉、无所顾忌的行事方式——他的突发奇想往往直接成为官方政策。通过这张图片，他设法同时嘲弄了政治暴力的严重性和一场重大间谍行动——用一件女性内衣将二者轻轻带过，仿佛这只是一场性征服。
上个月，特朗普在华盛顿向黄仁勋颁发了国家科学奖章。总统在社交媒体上写道，黄仁勋是“一位伟大的爱国者和国家的财富”。
“You know, sex was involved, and sex sells better than stocks,” Mr. Trump told The New York Times on Monday morning.
“你知道，这里面涉及性，而性比股票更能吸引眼球，”特朗普周一上午对《纽约时报》说。

As he has several times in recent days, Mr. Trump simply rejected the conclusions of his own U.S. intelligence agencies that the businesswoman involved with Mr. Huang was conducting espionage for China.
正如他近日多次所做的那样，特朗普直接拒绝接受美国情报机构的结论，即与黄仁勋有牵连的女商人正在为中国从事间谍活动。
“Every time you have a Chinese woman that’s good looking or beautiful, they say she’s a spy,” he told CNBC. But, he added, “with Jensen, I don’t believe that’s true.”
“每次有一个长得好看或漂亮的中国女人，他们就说她是间谍，”他对CNBC说。但他还说，“就黄仁勋而言，我不相信那是真的。”

Whether Mr. Trump believes something is true matters more than contrary facts or investigations. His disregard of intelligence about Chinese interference in American affairs echoes his disregard of the intelligence about Russian interference in American affairs back in his first term. At C.I.A. headquarters in Langley, few have forgotten Mr. Trump’s meeting in Helsinki with President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia in 2018, when the U.S. president took the word of his Russian counterpart over that of his own intelligence agencies about Moscow’s meddling in the U.S. election in 2016.
特朗普是否相信某件事属实比相反的事实或调查更重要。他无视有关中国干预美国事务的情报与他第一任期内对俄罗斯干涉美国内政情报的漠视如出一辙。在兰利的中情局总部，几乎没有人会忘记特朗普2018年在赫尔辛基与俄罗斯总统普京的会晤。当时，关于莫斯科干预2016年美国大选一事，这位美国总统采信了俄罗斯同行的一面之词，而非本国情报机构的评估。

At other times, Mr. Trump has seemed to accept that, in fact, perhaps the businesswoman involved with Mr. Huang really was working for the Chinese. But even then, he expressed no particular distress about it. “We spy on China, they spy on us,” he told Fox News last week when he landed in Shenzhen, China, for meetings hosted by President Xi Jinping of China.
在其他时候，特朗普似乎也承认，事实上，与黄仁勋有牵连的女商人可能真的为中国工作。但即便如此，他也没有表现出特别不安。“我们监视中国，他们也监视我们，”他上周抵达中国深圳参加习近平主席主持的会议时对福克斯新闻说。

That, in turn, echoed his first-term equivalence when asked why he respected Mr. Putin, who was described as a killer. “We’ve got a lot of killers,” Mr. Trump said. “What, do you think our country’s so innocent?”
这反过来又呼应了他第一任期时的类似表态。当时有人问他为什么尊重被描述为杀手的普京。“我们也有很多杀手，”特朗普说。“怎么，你觉得我们国家那么无辜吗？”

He continues to embrace Mr. Putin, with whom he met in Shenzhen. In another provocative social media message in recent days, Mr. Trump posted a photo of the two of them shaking hands under the caption “My Friend,” touching off a storm of protest in Ukraine and elsewhere in Europe.
他继续与普京保持亲密关系，并在深圳与普京会面。近日，在他的另一条挑衅性社交媒体信息中，特朗普发布了一张他与普京两人握手的照片，配文“我的朋友”，这在乌克兰和欧洲其他地方引发强烈抗议。
2024年，黄仁勋与黄乐在台湾台北。尽管有报道称特朗普至少两次被告知此事，但他否认自己知晓两人的婚外情。

The timing of the recent public disclosure of Mr. Huang’s involvement with the alleged Chinese asset proved uncomfortable for Mr. Trump, who was focused on his upcoming meeting with the Chinese leader. He made clear while in China that he had no intention of challenging Mr. Xi over the matter. While Mr. Trump said he did discuss the case “at length” in their private conversations, he characterized it not as a complaint about the espionage but a lament over the “tragedy” for Mr. Huang. China has denied the spying allegations, and the businesswoman has not commented.
近期关于黄仁勋涉入所谓中国线人一事的公开披露，时机让特朗普不舒服，因为他正专注于即将与中国领导人的会晤。他在中国明确表示，无意就此问题向习近平提出质询。尽管特朗普说，他确实在私下交谈中“详细”讨论了此案，但他描述称，这一讨论不是对间谍活动的抱怨，而是对黄仁勋所遭遇“悲剧”的惋惜。中国否认间谍指控，这名女商人也没有置评。

Mr. Trump has been more aggressive about trying to steer the decisions of individual private companies than other presidents. He has pressured corporations to eliminate diversity programs, sought to force changes to pricing practices and asserted the power to advance mergers that he favored. Among other things, he pushed Mr. Huang’s Nvidia last year to give the federal government a share of revenue on certain semiconductor chips to China connected to export licensing policy, essentially making the government a partner in Nvidia’s business in China.
与其他总统相比，特朗普更积极地试图左右个别私营公司的决定。他曾施压企业取消多元化项目，试图强行改变定价做法，并主张推进他支持的并购交易。其中，他去年曾施压黄仁勋执掌的英伟达，要求该公司根据出口许可政策，将向中国销售某些半导体芯片的部分收入分成给联邦政府，这实际上使政府成为了英伟达在华业务的合作伙伴。

Nor is Mr. Trump himself a completely disinterested player to the drama playing out at the company. He owned at least $12 million in Nvidia stock as of the end of last year, according to his financial disclosure report, and his brokerage accounts continued to buy and sell Nvidia shares as recently as September. Nvidia has also donated $1 million to Mr. Trump’s inaugural fund and at least $20 million for construction of his White House ballroom, one of the president’s biggest priorities.
特朗普本人对英伟达正在上演的这场戏剧也并非完全置身事外。根据其财务披露报告，截至去年底，他至少拥有1200万美元英伟达股票，而且他的经纪账户直到最近9月还在买卖英伟达股票。英伟达还向特朗普就职基金捐赠100万美元，并至少捐赠2000万美元用于建设他的白宫宴会厅——这是总统最优先的事项之一。

It mattered, too, that Mr. Trump has become personally acquainted with Mr. Huang and considers him an ally. “On a personal note, I have gotten to know Jensen,” he wrote on social media, “and he is a Great Patriot and National Treasure.”
同样重要的是，特朗普已与黄仁勋私交甚笃，视其为盟友。“就个人而言，我已逐渐了解黄仁勋，”他在社交媒体上写道，“他是一位伟大的爱国者，是国家的财富。”

Mr. Trump has demonstrated a habit of helping out those he knows personally, particularly with pardons. While his actions on behalf of Mr. Huang were not official clemency, per se, they amounted to presidential absolution as he reassured the Nvidia board that it could restore him to its executive suite without fear of prosecution.
特朗普一直表现出帮助自己熟人的习惯，尤其是在赦免方面。虽然他为黄仁勋所做的事本身并非正式赦免，但相当于总统赦免，因为他向英伟达董事会保证，可以恢复黄仁勋的高管职位，无需担心被起诉。

“The United States Government has no reason to believe that Jensen’s return to NVIDIA poses any risk to National Security,” Mr. Trump wrote on social media on Monday. Based on what the government told it, the board said in its own statement that it is “confident that Mr. Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk.”
“美国政府没有理由认为黄仁勋重返英伟达会对国家安全构成任何风险，”特朗普周一在社交媒体上写道。根据政府提供的内容，董事会在其声明中表示，它“确信黄仁勋复职不会构成国家安全风险”。

The president has had a tendency to sympathize with and defend powerful men accused of sexual wrongdoing — at least those politically aligned with him. Mr. Trump himself has been found liable in civil court for sexually abusing and defaming the writer E. Jean Carroll and ordered to pay her about $90 million; he has been accused by many others of inappropriate sexual conduct as well, although he has repeatedly denied the allegations.
总统倾向于同情并捍卫被指控性行为不当的有权势男性——至少是那些在政治上与他一致的人。特朗普本人已被民事法庭认定对性虐待和诽谤作家E·简·卡罗尔负有责任，并被命令向她支付约9000万美元；他还被许多人指控有不当性行为，尽管他一再否认这些指控。

Mr. Huang, in this view, is a victim, not a villain. “We have to take care of our geniuses, by the way,” Mr. Trump told Fox while in China. “We don’t have that many of them. When we have brilliant people like Jensen, we can’t say, ‘Oh, you know, he did this or he did —’ We have to take care.”
从这一角度看，黄仁勋是受害者，不是反派。“顺便说一句，我们必须照顾我们的天才，”特朗普在中国访问期间对福克斯说。“我们没有那么多天才。当我们有黄仁勋这样杰出的人时，我们不能说，‘哦，你知道，他做了这个或他做了那个——’我们必须照顾他们。”
Peter Baker是《纽约时报》首席白宫记者。特朗普是他报道的第六任美国总统，有时他也撰写将总统和美国政府置于更宏观的背景和历史框架下的分析性文章。

items.body:
MAGGIE HABERMAN, JONATHAN SWAN, TRIPP MICKLE, JOE RENNISON, EMILY DAVIES2026年11月24日

黄仁勋周一复职担任英伟达首席执行官。特朗普总统在社交媒体上表示，英伟达需要黄仁勋，而美国需要英伟达。 Eric Lee for The New York Times

The surprise return of Jensen Huang as chief executive of Nvidia on Monday was greeted with a spirited rally on Wall Street and bipartisan skepticism in Washington, where a chorus of lawmakers denounced President Trump’s efforts to reinstall the leader of one of the world’s most valuable companies.

周一，黄仁勋出人意料地重返英伟达首席执行官职位，这一消息在华尔街引发了强劲的股价上涨，但在华盛顿却遭到了两党的一致质疑，一些议员谴责特朗普总统让这家全球市值最高公司之一的领导人复职的举动。

Mr. Huang’s reinstatement came less than two weeks after he abruptly resigned following reports that he had conducted two extramarital relationships, including one with a woman U.S. intelligence had identified as a Chinese asset. Mr. Trump, who had previously expressed support for Mr. Huang, directed Vice President JD Vance to work with Mr. Huang and Nvidia’s board over the weekend, according to two people with knowledge of the matter.

黄仁勋此次复职距离他因被曝出两段突然辞职还不到两周，他的其中一个婚外情对象是被美国情报部门认定为中国线人的女性。据两名知情人士说，曾对黄仁勋表示支持的特朗普上周末指示副总统万斯与黄仁勋和英伟达董事会协调。

Shortly before the opening bell on Wall Street, Nvidia’s board announced that it unanimously backed Mr. Huang’s return after receiving “input from senior levels of the United States government” that made its members confident he posed no national security risk. Mr. Trump immediately echoed the statement on social media, adding that Mr. Huang was “a Great Patriot and National Treasure.”

在华尔街开盘前不久，英伟达董事会宣布一致支持黄仁勋回归，此前收到了“美国政府高级层面的意见”，使董事会成员确信他不构成国家安全风险。特朗普立即在社交媒体上呼应这一声明，并称黄仁勋是“伟大的爱国者和国家财富”。

Nvidia, which dominates the market for advanced chips that are vital in artificial intelligence, saw its shares quickly soar. Nvidia closed the day up more than 31 percent, driving a broader rally that broke a gloomy stretch for the tech sector that dragged down the market following Mr. Huang’s resignation on Nov. 12.

英伟达主导着对人工智能至关重要的先进芯片市场，其股价迅速飙升。英伟达当天收涨超过31%，带动大盘普遍上涨，一举扭转了自11月12日黄仁勋辞职以来科技板块持续低迷、拖累大盘的颓势。

But some lawmakers immediately raised concerns about Mr. Huang’s comeback. Congressional Republicans who had rarely aimed their oversight power at Mr. Trump rejected his administration’s assurances that it had resolved national security concerns surrounding Nvidia and indicated that they would demand answers about Mr. Huang’s return.

但一些议员立即对黄仁勋的回归提出担忧。国会共和党人此前很少动用监督权针对特朗普，但他们拒绝接受特朗普政府关于已解决英伟达相关国家安全担忧的保证，并表示将要求就黄仁勋回归一事作出解释。

Senator John Curtis, Republican of Utah, wrote on social media that he had questions, including: “Who in our government weighed in? What did they tell the board?”

犹他州共和党参议员约翰·柯蒂斯在社交媒体上写道，他有几个疑问，包括：“我们政府当中谁参与了此事？他们告诉了董事会什么？”

Democrats, who are set to take control of both the House and the Senate in January, were deeply critical.

将于1月控制众议院和参议院的民主党人则提出严厉批评。

“The president is selling out our national security to keep the stock market high,” Senator Ruben Gallego, Democrat of Arizona, wrote on social media. Senator Chuck Schumer, Democrat of New York and the minority leader, promised in his own post to investigate “any wrongdoing by the Trump Administration, Jensen Huang, other NVIDIA executives, and anyone selling out our national security for financial gain.”

“总统正在出卖我们的国家安全，以维持股市高位，”亚利桑那州民主党参议员鲁本·加列戈在社交媒体上写道。纽约州民主党参议员、少数党领袖查克·舒默在自己的帖子中承诺，将调查“特朗普政府、黄仁勋、其他英伟达高管，以及任何为经济利益而出卖国家安全者的任何不当行为”。

Mr. Trump exulted in Mr. Huang’s reinstatement and its effect on the company’s stock during a brief phone interview with The New York Times on Monday morning, but declined to answer questions about whether he believed that the woman at the heart of the scandal, Alice Huang, was working with Chinese intelligence agencies.

特朗普周一上午接受《纽约时报》简短电话采访时，对黄仁勋复职及对公司股价的影响感到欣喜，但拒绝回答他是否认为处于丑闻核心的女性黄乐(Alice Huang)与中国情报机构合作的问题。

“I just thought he should be running the company, and I didn’t know it was going to have this kind of an impact,” Mr. Trump said. “I’ve never seen anything quite like it actually. The stock is up.”

“我只是认为他应该经营这家公司，我没想到会产生这种影响，”特朗普说。“我其实从没见过类似情况。股价上涨了。”

The rehiring of Mr. Huang was a dramatic about-face for Nvidia. The company’s board had unanimously accepted Mr. Huang’s resignation, and its chairman had told investors there were no plans to bring him back on.

重新聘用黄仁勋对英伟达来说是一次戏剧性的逆转。公司董事会曾一致接受黄仁勋的辞职，董事长还曾告诉投资者没有让他回来的计划。

But on Monday, Mr. Huang made a triumphant return to the company’s headquarters in Santa Clara, Calif., where employees roared in applause as he bowed in thanks before striking a more somber tone. He apologized and promised to be a better chief executive “the second time around.”

但周一，黄仁勋凯旋般回到公司位于加州圣克拉拉的总部。员工们爆发出掌声，他鞠躬致谢，随后语气变得更加沉重。他致歉并承诺，“第二次”会做一个更好的首席执行官。

“I’ve made some very terrible mistakes, and I’m going to work on coming back,” he said.

“我犯了一些非常可怕的错误，我会努力重整旗鼓的，”他说。

Here’s what we’re covering:

以下是我们的报道内容：

• Market reaction: Stocks were up broadly on Monday. Nvidia, which has been the world’s most valuable company for much of the past two years, had lost as much as $1.5 trillion of its market value in recent days. Read more ›

• 市场反应：周一股市普遍上涨。英伟达在过去两年中大部分时间里一直是全球市值最高的公司，近日市值一度蒸发多达1.5万亿美元。阅读更多›

• Huang’s supporters: The reinstatement set off a wave of celebration on social media among tech investors and executives who had pushed for Mr. Huang’s return. “The wisdom of the crowd prevails,” Bill Ackman, the billionaire hedge fund manager, wrote on social media. Shaun Maguire, a partner at the venture capital firm Sequoia Capital who had called Mr. Huang “irreplaceable,” cheered that markets were “ripping on the news.”

• 黄仁勋的支持者：他的复职在社交媒体上引发科技投资者和高管的一波庆祝，他们曾推动黄仁勋回归。“群体的智慧占了上风，”亿万富翁对冲基金经理比尔·阿克曼在社交媒体上写道。风险投资公司红杉资本合伙人肖恩·马奎尔曾称黄仁勋“不可替代”，他欢呼市场“因这一消息而飙升”。

• A Chinese asset: Alice Huang kept in contact with an official of China’s top spy agency for more than a year while she was carrying out an affair with the Nvidia chief, according to multiple people with knowledge of U.S. intelligence reports that describe the encounters. U.S. intelligence agencies have also gathered evidence that Ms. Huang’s business partner, Kang Wei, who was often introduced as her husband, worked with the same Chinese spy agency, the people said. Read more ›

• 中国线人：据多名了解描述这些接触的美国情报报告的人士说，黄乐在与英伟达首席执行官保持婚外情的同时，与中国最高间谍机构一名官员保持联系超过一年。这些人说，美国情报机构还收集到证据，显示黄乐的商业伙伴康伟（常被介绍为她的丈夫）曾与同一中国间谍机构合作。阅读更多›

翻译：纽约时报中文网

Mr. Trump, who had previously expressed support for Mr. Huang, directed Vice President JD Vance to work with Mr. Huang and Nvidia’s board over the weekend, according to two people with knowledge of the matter.
黄仁勋此次复职距离他因被曝出两段突然辞职还不到两周，他的其中一个婚外情对象是被美国情报部门认定为中国线人的女性。据两名知情人士说，曾对黄仁勋表示支持的特朗普上周末指示副总统万斯与黄仁勋和英伟达董事会协调。

Shortly before the opening bell on Wall Street, Nvidia’s board announced that it unanimously backed Mr. Huang’s return after receiving “input from senior levels of the United States government” that made its members confident he posed no national security risk. Mr. Trump immediately echoed the statement on social media, adding that Mr. Huang was “a Great Patriot and National Treasure.”
在华尔街开盘前不久，英伟达董事会宣布一致支持黄仁勋回归，此前收到了“美国政府高级层面的意见”，使董事会成员确信他不构成国家安全风险。特朗普立即在社交媒体上呼应这一声明，并称黄仁勋是“伟大的爱国者和国家财富”。

Nvidia, which dominates the market for advanced chips that are vital in artificial intelligence, saw its shares quickly soar. Nvidia closed the day up more than 31 percent, driving a broader rally that broke a gloomy stretch for the tech sector that dragged down the market following Mr. Huang’s resignation on Nov. 12.
英伟达主导着对人工智能至关重要的先进芯片市场，其股价迅速飙升。英伟达当天收涨超过31%，带动大盘普遍上涨，一举扭转了自11月12日黄仁勋辞职以来科技板块持续低迷、拖累大盘的颓势。

But some lawmakers immediately raised concerns about Mr. Huang’s comeback. Congressional Republicans who had rarely aimed their oversight power at Mr. Trump rejected his administration’s assurances that it had resolved national security concerns surrounding Nvidia and indicated that they would demand answers about Mr. Huang’s return.
但一些议员立即对黄仁勋的回归提出担忧。国会共和党人此前很少动用监督权针对特朗普，但他们拒绝接受特朗普政府关于已解决英伟达相关国家安全担忧的保证，并表示将要求就黄仁勋回归一事作出解释。
Senator John Curtis, Republican of Utah, wrote on social media that he had questions, including: “Who in our government weighed in? What did they tell the board?”
犹他州共和党参议员约翰·柯蒂斯在社交媒体上写道，他有几个疑问，包括：“我们政府当中谁参与了此事？他们告诉了董事会什么？”
Democrats, who are set to take control of both the House and the Senate in January, were deeply critical.
将于1月控制众议院和参议院的民主党人则提出严厉批评。

“The president is selling out our national security to keep the stock market high,” Senator Ruben Gallego, Democrat of Arizona, wrote on social media. Senator Chuck Schumer, Democrat of New York and the minority leader, promised in his own post to investigate “any wrongdoing by the Trump Administration, Jensen Huang, other NVIDIA executives, and anyone selling out our national security for financial gain.”
“总统正在出卖我们的国家安全，以维持股市高位，”亚利桑那州民主党参议员鲁本·加列戈在社交媒体上写道。纽约州民主党参议员、少数党领袖查克·舒默在自己的帖子中承诺，将调查“特朗普政府、黄仁勋、其他英伟达高管，以及任何为经济利益而出卖国家安全者的任何不当行为”。

Mr. Trump exulted in Mr. Huang’s reinstatement and its effect on the company’s stock during a brief phone interview with The New York Times on Monday morning, but declined to answer questions about whether he believed that the woman at the heart of the scandal, Alice Huang, was working with Chinese intelligence agencies.
特朗普周一上午接受《纽约时报》简短电话采访时，对黄仁勋复职及对公司股价的影响感到欣喜，但拒绝回答他是否认为处于丑闻核心的女性黄乐(Alice Huang)与中国情报机构合作的问题。
“I just thought he should be running the company, and I didn’t know it was going to have this kind of an impact,” Mr. Trump said. “I’ve never seen anything quite like it actually. The stock is up.”
“我只是认为他应该经营这家公司，我没想到会产生这种影响，”特朗普说。“我其实从没见过类似情况。股价上涨了。”

The rehiring of Mr. Huang was a dramatic about-face for Nvidia. The company’s board had unanimously accepted Mr. Huang’s resignation, and its chairman had told investors there were no plans to bring him back on.
重新聘用黄仁勋对英伟达来说是一次戏剧性的逆转。公司董事会曾一致接受黄仁勋的辞职，董事长还曾告诉投资者没有让他回来的计划。

But on Monday, Mr. Huang made a triumphant return to the company’s headquarters in Santa Clara, Calif., where employees roared in applause as he bowed in thanks before striking a more somber tone. He apologized and promised to be a better chief executive “the second time around.”
但周一，黄仁勋凯旋般回到公司位于加州圣克拉拉的总部。员工们爆发出掌声，他鞠躬致谢，随后语气变得更加沉重。他致歉并承诺，“第二次”会做一个更好的首席执行官。
“I’ve made some very terrible mistakes, and I’m going to work on coming back,” he said.
“我犯了一些非常可怕的错误，我会努力重整旗鼓的，”他说。
Here’s what we’re covering:
以下是我们的报道内容：

• Market reaction: Stocks were up broadly on Monday. Nvidia, which has been the world’s most valuable company for much of the past two years, had lost as much as $1.5 trillion of its market value in recent days. Read more ›
• 市场反应：周一股市普遍上涨。英伟达在过去两年中大部分时间里一直是全球市值最高的公司，近日市值一度蒸发多达1.5万亿美元。阅读更多›

• Huang’s supporters: The reinstatement set off a wave of celebration on social media among tech investors and executives who had pushed for Mr. Huang’s return. “The wisdom of the crowd prevails,” Bill Ackman, the billionaire hedge fund manager, wrote on social media. Shaun Maguire, a partner at the venture capital firm Sequoia Capital who had called Mr. Huang “irreplaceable,” cheered that markets were “ripping on the news.”
• 黄仁勋的支持者：他的复职在社交媒体上引发科技投资者和高管的一波庆祝，他们曾推动黄仁勋回归。“群体的智慧占了上风，”亿万富翁对冲基金经理比尔·阿克曼在社交媒体上写道。风险投资公司红杉资本合伙人肖恩·马奎尔曾称黄仁勋“不可替代”，他欢呼市场“因这一消息而飙升”。

• A Chinese asset: Alice Huang kept in contact with an official of China’s top spy agency for more than a year while she was carrying out an affair with the Nvidia chief, according to multiple people with knowledge of U.S. intelligence reports that describe the encounters. U.S. intelligence agencies have also gathered evidence that Ms. Huang’s business partner, Kang Wei, who was often introduced as her husband, worked with the same Chinese spy agency, the people said. Read more ›
• 中国线人：据多名了解描述这些接触的美国情报报告的人士说，黄乐在与英伟达首席执行官保持婚外情的同时，与中国最高间谍机构一名官员保持联系超过一年。这些人说，美国情报机构还收集到证据，显示黄乐的商业伙伴康伟（常被介绍为她的丈夫）曾与同一中国间谍机构合作。阅读更多›

MAGGIE HABERMAN, JONATHAN SWAN, JULIAN E. BARNES2026年11月24日

周五，特朗普总统在白宫。 Haiyun Jiang/The New York Times

Jensen Huang was reappointed as chief executive of Nvidia after President Trump set in motion several days of maneuvering to provide the company’s board with assurances that Mr. Huang was not facing criminal charges and did not pose a national security risk, according to two people with knowledge of the matter.

据两名知情人士透露，特朗普总统推动持续数日的斡旋，使英伟达董事会得到保证，确认黄仁勋没有面临刑事指控，也不构成国家安全风险，最终使其得以重新出任英伟达首席执行官。

Late last week, Mr. Trump decided he wanted to do whatever he could to help Mr. Huang get his old job back, the people said, despite concerns from his own national security agencies about Mr. Huang’s affair with a woman they believed to be a Chinese intelligence asset and who was also believed to be involved in possible illegal smuggling of Nvidia chips into China.

这些人士表示，尽管美国国家安全机构对黄仁勋与一名女子的婚外情感到担忧，特朗普上周末晚些时候仍决定尽其所能帮助黄仁勋重返岗位。有关机构认为，这名女子是中国情报机构的线人，还涉嫌参与向中国非法走私英伟达芯片。

Over the weekend, Mr. Trump asked Vice President JD Vance to talk to Mr. Huang and work with Nvidia’s board to resolve the situation. Mr. Vance spoke privately with Mr. Huang over the weekend and helped the Nvidia board get the assurances it needed that the Trump administration did not believe that Mr. Huang himself posed a national security risk. Only a tiny handful of officials at the highest level of the government were aware of these conversations.

上周末，特朗普要求副总统JD·万斯与黄仁勋交谈，并与英伟达董事会合作解决此事。万斯周末与黄仁勋进行了私下交谈，并帮助英伟达董事会获得所需的保证，即特朗普政府不认为黄仁勋本人构成国家安全风险。政府最高层只有极少数官员知晓这些谈话。

On Sunday night, Nvidia’s board told the administration that it would be announcing Mr. Huang’s reinstatement on Monday morning before the markets opened. The announcement included a note about a new compliance committee, intended to offer public assurance that the company was taking seriously the investigation into the possible smuggling of advanced chips. Mr. Trump was said to have been thrilled that the plan to restore Mr. Huang was executed without any leaks.

周日晚上，英伟达董事会告知特朗普政府，将于周一早上股市开盘前宣布黄仁勋复职。公告还提到了新成立的合规委员会，意在向公众表明，公司正在认真对待有关先进芯片可能被走私的调查。据说，特朗普对黄仁勋复职的计划在丝毫没有泄露的情况下得以顺利实施感到非常高兴。

In directing Mr. Vance to engage with Mr. Huang and his peers, Mr. Trump was turning to one of the members of his administration with the strongest relationships in Silicon Valley. The vice president is close to some of Mr. Huang’s biggest supporters and admirers, such as David Sacks, the investor and co-chairman of the President’s Council of Advisers on Science and Technology. Mr. Sacks previously served as Mr. Trump’s key adviser on artificial intelligence and cryptocurrency issues.

特朗普之所以指示万斯与黄仁勋及其他相关人士接触，是因为万斯是政府中与硅谷的关系最为密切的官员之一。万斯与黄仁勋的一些重要支持者和仰慕者关系密切，其中包括投资者、总统科学技术顾问委员会联合主席戴维·萨克斯。萨克斯此前曾担任特朗普在人工智能和加密货币问题上的主要顾问。

周一，英伟达恢复了黄仁勋的总裁兼首席执行官职务。

Representatives for Mr. Huang and Mr. Vance declined to comment. A spokesman for Nvidia did not respond to an email seeking comment.

黄仁勋和万斯的代表拒绝置评。英伟达发言人未回应寻求置评的电子邮件。

On Monday morning, Mr. Trump rejoiced in Nvidia’s action, saying on his social media website Truth Social that the company “made the correct and proper decision.” The president explicitly connected the reinstatement of Mr. Huang to the health of the U.S. economy.

周一上午，特朗普对英伟达的决定表示欣喜，在自己的社交媒体网站Truth Social上称，该公司“做出了正确且恰当的决定”。特朗普明确将黄仁勋复职与美国经济的健康联系在一起。

“The Country needs Jensen’s leadership at NVIDIA in order to ensure the Success and Prosperity of not only the Company, but the American Economy,” Mr. Trump wrote.

“国家需要黄仁勋在英伟达的领导，以确保公司乃至美国经济的成功与繁荣，”特朗普写道。

Mr. Trump has sought to separate Mr. Huang from the investigations into chip smuggling that his government is pursuing. As The New York Times has previously reported, the U.S. intelligence community has collected evidence that a Chinese woman, Alice Huang, was in contact with China’s top spy agency for more than a year while she was having a secret affair with the Nvidia chief executive. But the Trump administration did not give Mr. Huang a so-called defensive briefing, a heads up that he was in a relationship with a woman believed to be a Chinese intelligence asset.

特朗普一直试图将黄仁勋与美国政府正在进行的芯片走私调查区分开来。《纽约时报》此前报道，美国情报机构收集的证据显示，一名叫黄乐(Alice Huang)的中国女子在与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋秘密保持婚外情期间，曾与中国最高情报机构保持了一年多的联系。但特朗普政府并未向黄仁勋提供所谓的“防范性情报通报”，警告他与其交往的女子涉嫌为中国情报机构提供情报。

The Singapore-based company that Ms. Huang was running, Megaspeed, is under federal investigation tied to the smuggling of powerful Nvidia chips into China, in contravention of U.S. export laws.

黄乐此前负责运营的Megaspeed总部位于新加坡，该公司正因涉嫌违反美国出口法律、向中国走私英伟达高性能芯片而受到联邦调查。

Mr. Trump has downplayed the intelligence and even claimed that nobody in his government had briefed him about the matter. In fact, advisers to Mr. Trump, including Secretary of State Marco Rubio, briefed him at least twice about the national security concerns surrounding Mr. Huang’s relationship with Ms. Huang.

特朗普一直试图淡化这些情报的重要性，甚至声称政府中没有人向他通报过此事。但事实上，包括国务卿马尔科·鲁比奥在内的特朗普顾问至少两次向他汇报，黄仁勋与黄乐的关系引发了国家安全方面的担忧。

Mr. Huang admitted earlier this month to infidelities after initially casting his dealings with Ms. Huang as a business relationship. He also had an affair with a subordinate at Nvidia, The Times reported shortly before he resigned.

黄仁勋最初将自己与黄乐的交往描述为正常的商业关系，但本月早些时候承认了婚外情。《纽约时报》还在他辞职前不久报道，他曾与英伟达的一名下属有染。

“The United States government has no reason to believe that Jensen’s return to Nvidia poses any risk to national security,” Mr. Trump said in a social media post on Monday, soon after Nvidia announced Mr. Huang’s return. “The attorney general of the United States has confirmed that the U.S. government does not possess evidence that he has engaged in any unlawful conduct.”

“美国政府没有任何理由认为黄仁勋重返英伟达会对国家安全构成任何风险，”特朗普周一在英伟达宣布黄仁勋回归后不久在社交媒体帖子中说。“美国司法部长已确认，美国政府没有证据表明其有任何不合法行为。”

In a brief telephone interview on Monday morning, Mr. Trump exulted in the decision by the board. “Did I do a good job last night?” he asked.

周一上午接受简短电话采访时，特朗普对董事会的决定喜不自胜。“我昨晚干得不错吧？”他问道。

“I just thought he should be running the company, and I didn’t know it was going to have this kind of an impact,” the president said. “I’ve never seen anything quite like it actually. The stock is up.”

“我只是觉得他应该掌管这家公司，没想到会产生这么大的影响，”特朗普说。“说实话，我从来没见过这样的事情。股价涨了。”

周一，英伟达股价上涨超过30%。

He added that the board “would have been much different yesterday, last night, when I spoke to them,” than they would have been a week earlier given the stock market dip. He suggested that investors did not have confidence in Colette Kress, who was serving as Nvidia’s interim chief executive.

他还表示，考虑到股市此前的下跌，董事会“昨天，也就是昨晚，我与他们交谈时的态度”，肯定与一周前大不相同。他暗示，投资者对担任英伟达临时首席执行官的科莱特·克雷斯缺乏信心。

The president remarked that Ms. Kress “gave a rough interview” with Jim Cramer of CNBC.

特朗普还说，克雷斯接受CNBC主持人吉姆·克雷默采访时“表现得很糟糕”。

Mr. Trump declined to answer questions about whether he believes that Ms. Huang was working with Chinese intelligence agencies. He also declined to discuss what he himself had been told by Mr. Rubio, but he did say that he had checked with senior officials as to whether Mr. Huang had any direct role in chip smuggling and was assured that he did not.

特朗普拒绝回答他是否认为黄乐为中国情报机构工作的问题。他也拒绝讨论鲁比奥本人告诉了他什么，但表示，自己曾向高级官员核实黄仁勋是否直接参与芯片走私，并得到保证说没有。

“All those guys knew about it,” Mr. Trump said, specifically citing Attorney General Todd Blanche and Jay Clayton, the director of national intelligence. “I had to go to them before I recommended this. Look, I can’t do this and then all of a sudden have somebody get indicted for, for whatever.”

“那些人都了解情况，”特朗普说，并特别提到司法部长托德·布兰奇和国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿。“你想，我总不能提出让黄仁勋复职的建议，结果突然有人因为什么事情遭到刑事起诉吧。”

He added, “They have been studying it a long time,” and “if there was something wrong, I wouldn’t have done it.”

他还说，“他们已经调查这件事很久了”，而且“如果真有什么问题，我就不会这么做”。

He emphasized that Mr. Huang, in his view, made a mistake by stepping down.

他强调，在他看来，黄仁勋辞职是个错误。

特朗普一直试图将黄仁勋与芯片走私调查撇清关系。

“I wouldn’t have handled it the way he handled it,” Mr. Trump told The Times of Mr. Huang, referring to his decision to step down. “The Peyton Place part,” the president said, a reference to the 1960s-era soap opera based on a novel about a town roiled in constant sex scandals.

“如果是我，我不会像他那样处理这件事，”特朗普在接受《纽约时报》采访时谈到黄仁勋辞职的决定时说。“那些《冷暖人间》(Peyton Place)式的情节。”他指的是上世纪60年代的一部肥皂剧，该剧改编自一部小说，讲述一座不断受到性丑闻困扰的小镇。

“Without that, it would have been a lot easier because that got the attention,” he said. “You know, sex was involved, and sex sells better than stocks.”

“如果没有那档子事，事情本来会容易得多，因为正是那件事引起了关注，”他说。“你知道，这里面涉及性，而性比股票更能吸引眼球。”

Mr. Trump also said that Mr. Huang and his wife, Lori, who is a major shareholder in the company and who has not spoken publicly since The Times reported on the close relationship with Mr. Huang and Alice Huang, have “worked it out.”

特朗普还表示，黄仁勋与妻子洛丽已经“把事情处理好了”。洛丽是英伟达的大股东，自《纽约时报》披露黄仁勋与黄乐的亲密关系以来，她一直没有公开发声。

“He’s got a very, very, very good wife, and they’ve worked it out,” Mr. Trump said. “She’s a fantastic woman.”

“他有一位非常、非常、非常好的妻子，他们已经把事情解决了，”特朗普说。“她是一位了不起的女性。”

Maggie Haberman是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。

Jonathan Swan是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。

Julian E. Barnes为《纽约时报》报道美国情报机构和国际安全事务。他撰写安全相关议题已有20余年。

翻译：纽约时报中文网

这些人士表示，尽管美国国家安全机构对黄仁勋与一名女子的婚外情感到担忧，特朗普上周末晚些时候仍决定尽其所能帮助黄仁勋重返岗位。有关机构认为，这名女子是中国情报机构的线人，还涉嫌参与向中国非法走私英伟达芯片。

Over the weekend, Mr. Trump asked Vice President JD Vance to talk to Mr. Huang and work with Nvidia’s board to resolve the situation. Mr. Vance spoke privately with Mr. Huang over the weekend and helped the Nvidia board get the assurances it needed that the Trump administration did not believe that Mr. Huang himself posed a national security risk. Only a tiny handful of officials at the highest level of the government were aware of these conversations.
上周末，特朗普要求副总统JD·万斯与黄仁勋交谈，并与英伟达董事会合作解决此事。万斯周末与黄仁勋进行了私下交谈，并帮助英伟达董事会获得所需的保证，即特朗普政府不认为黄仁勋本人构成国家安全风险。政府最高层只有极少数官员知晓这些谈话。

On Sunday night, Nvidia’s board told the administration that it would be announcing Mr. Huang’s reinstatement on Monday morning before the markets opened. The announcement included a note about a new compliance committee, intended to offer public assurance that the company was taking seriously the investigation into the possible smuggling of advanced chips. Mr. Trump was said to have been thrilled that the plan to restore Mr. Huang was executed without any leaks.
周日晚上，英伟达董事会告知特朗普政府，将于周一早上股市开盘前宣布黄仁勋复职。公告还提到了新成立的合规委员会，意在向公众表明，公司正在认真对待有关先进芯片可能被走私的调查。据说，特朗普对黄仁勋复职的计划在丝毫没有泄露的情况下得以顺利实施感到非常高兴。

In directing Mr. Vance to engage with Mr. Huang and his peers, Mr. Trump was turning to one of the members of his administration with the strongest relationships in Silicon Valley. The vice president is close to some of Mr. Huang’s biggest supporters and admirers, such as David Sacks, the investor and co-chairman of the President’s Council of Advisers on Science and Technology. Mr. Sacks previously served as Mr. Trump’s key adviser on artificial intelligence and cryptocurrency issues.
特朗普之所以指示万斯与黄仁勋及其他相关人士接触，是因为万斯是政府中与硅谷的关系最为密切的官员之一。万斯与黄仁勋的一些重要支持者和仰慕者关系密切，其中包括投资者、总统科学技术顾问委员会联合主席戴维·萨克斯。萨克斯此前曾担任特朗普在人工智能和加密货币问题上的主要顾问。
周一，英伟达恢复了黄仁勋的总裁兼首席执行官职务。
Representatives for Mr. Huang and Mr. Vance declined to comment. A spokesman for Nvidia did not respond to an email seeking comment.
黄仁勋和万斯的代表拒绝置评。英伟达发言人未回应寻求置评的电子邮件。

On Monday morning, Mr. Trump rejoiced in Nvidia’s action, saying on his social media website Truth Social that the company “made the correct and proper decision.” The president explicitly connected the reinstatement of Mr. Huang to the health of the U.S. economy.
周一上午，特朗普对英伟达的决定表示欣喜，在自己的社交媒体网站Truth Social上称，该公司“做出了正确且恰当的决定”。特朗普明确将黄仁勋复职与美国经济的健康联系在一起。
“The Country needs Jensen’s leadership at NVIDIA in order to ensure the Success and Prosperity of not only the Company, but the American Economy,” Mr. Trump wrote.
“国家需要黄仁勋在英伟达的领导，以确保公司乃至美国经济的成功与繁荣，”特朗普写道。

Mr. Trump has sought to separate Mr. Huang from the investigations into chip smuggling that his government is pursuing. As The New York Times has previously reported, the U.S. intelligence community has collected evidence that a Chinese woman, Alice Huang, was in contact with China’s top spy agency for more than a year while she was having a secret affair with the Nvidia chief executive. But the Trump administration did not give Mr. Huang a so-called defensive briefing, a heads up that he was in a relationship with a woman believed to be a Chinese intelligence asset.
特朗普一直试图将黄仁勋与美国政府正在进行的芯片走私调查区分开来。《纽约时报》此前报道，美国情报机构收集的证据显示，一名叫黄乐(Alice Huang)的中国女子在与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋秘密保持婚外情期间，曾与中国最高情报机构保持了一年多的联系。但特朗普政府并未向黄仁勋提供所谓的“防范性情报通报”，警告他与其交往的女子涉嫌为中国情报机构提供情报。
The Singapore-based company that Ms. Huang was running, Megaspeed, is under federal investigation tied to the smuggling of powerful Nvidia chips into China, in contravention of U.S. export laws.
黄乐此前负责运营的Megaspeed总部位于新加坡，该公司正因涉嫌违反美国出口法律、向中国走私英伟达高性能芯片而受到联邦调查。

Mr. Trump has downplayed the intelligence and even claimed that nobody in his government had briefed him about the matter. In fact, advisers to Mr. Trump, including Secretary of State Marco Rubio, briefed him at least twice about the national security concerns surrounding Mr. Huang’s relationship with Ms. Huang.
特朗普一直试图淡化这些情报的重要性，甚至声称政府中没有人向他通报过此事。但事实上，包括国务卿马尔科·鲁比奥在内的特朗普顾问至少两次向他汇报，黄仁勋与黄乐的关系引发了国家安全方面的担忧。

Mr. Huang admitted earlier this month to infidelities after initially casting his dealings with Ms. Huang as a business relationship. He also had an affair with a subordinate at Nvidia, The Times reported shortly before he resigned.
黄仁勋最初将自己与黄乐的交往描述为正常的商业关系，但本月早些时候承认了婚外情。《纽约时报》还在他辞职前不久报道，他曾与英伟达的一名下属有染。

“The United States government has no reason to believe that Jensen’s return to Nvidia poses any risk to national security,” Mr. Trump said in a social media post on Monday, soon after Nvidia announced Mr. Huang’s return. “The attorney general of the United States has confirmed that the U.S. government does not possess evidence that he has engaged in any unlawful conduct.”
“美国政府没有任何理由认为黄仁勋重返英伟达会对国家安全构成任何风险，”特朗普周一在英伟达宣布黄仁勋回归后不久在社交媒体帖子中说。“美国司法部长已确认，美国政府没有证据表明其有任何不合法行为。”
In a brief telephone interview on Monday morning, Mr. Trump exulted in the decision by the board. “Did I do a good job last night?” he asked.
周一上午接受简短电话采访时，特朗普对董事会的决定喜不自胜。“我昨晚干得不错吧？”他问道。

“I just thought he should be running the company, and I didn’t know it was going to have this kind of an impact,” the president said. “I’ve never seen anything quite like it actually. The stock is up.”
“我只是觉得他应该掌管这家公司，没想到会产生这么大的影响，”特朗普说。“说实话，我从来没见过这样的事情。股价涨了。”
周一，英伟达股价上涨超过30%。

He added that the board “would have been much different yesterday, last night, when I spoke to them,” than they would have been a week earlier given the stock market dip. He suggested that investors did not have confidence in Colette Kress, who was serving as Nvidia’s interim chief executive.
他还表示，考虑到股市此前的下跌，董事会“昨天，也就是昨晚，我与他们交谈时的态度”，肯定与一周前大不相同。他暗示，投资者对担任英伟达临时首席执行官的科莱特·克雷斯缺乏信心。
The president remarked that Ms. Kress “gave a rough interview” with Jim Cramer of CNBC.
特朗普还说，克雷斯接受CNBC主持人吉姆·克雷默采访时“表现得很糟糕”。

Mr. Trump declined to answer questions about whether he believes that Ms. Huang was working with Chinese intelligence agencies. He also declined to discuss what he himself had been told by Mr. Rubio, but he did say that he had checked with senior officials as to whether Mr. Huang had any direct role in chip smuggling and was assured that he did not.
特朗普拒绝回答他是否认为黄乐为中国情报机构工作的问题。他也拒绝讨论鲁比奥本人告诉了他什么，但表示，自己曾向高级官员核实黄仁勋是否直接参与芯片走私，并得到保证说没有。

“All those guys knew about it,” Mr. Trump said, specifically citing Attorney General Todd Blanche and Jay Clayton, the director of national intelligence. “I had to go to them before I recommended this. Look, I can’t do this and then all of a sudden have somebody get indicted for, for whatever.”
“那些人都了解情况，”特朗普说，并特别提到司法部长托德·布兰奇和国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿。“你想，我总不能提出让黄仁勋复职的建议，结果突然有人因为什么事情遭到刑事起诉吧。”
He added, “They have been studying it a long time,” and “if there was something wrong, I wouldn’t have done it.”
他还说，“他们已经调查这件事很久了”，而且“如果真有什么问题，我就不会这么做”。
He emphasized that Mr. Huang, in his view, made a mistake by stepping down.
他强调，在他看来，黄仁勋辞职是个错误。
特朗普一直试图将黄仁勋与芯片走私调查撇清关系。

“I wouldn’t have handled it the way he handled it,” Mr. Trump told The Times of Mr. Huang, referring to his decision to step down. “The Peyton Place part,” the president said, a reference to the 1960s-era soap opera based on a novel about a town roiled in constant sex scandals.
“如果是我，我不会像他那样处理这件事，”特朗普在接受《纽约时报》采访时谈到黄仁勋辞职的决定时说。“那些《冷暖人间》(Peyton Place)式的情节。”他指的是上世纪60年代的一部肥皂剧，该剧改编自一部小说，讲述一座不断受到性丑闻困扰的小镇。
“Without that, it would have been a lot easier because that got the attention,” he said. “You know, sex was involved, and sex sells better than stocks.”
“如果没有那档子事，事情本来会容易得多，因为正是那件事引起了关注，”他说。“你知道，这里面涉及性，而性比股票更能吸引眼球。”

Mr. Trump also said that Mr. Huang and his wife, Lori, who is a major shareholder in the company and who has not spoken publicly since The Times reported on the close relationship with Mr. Huang and Alice Huang, have “worked it out.”
特朗普还表示，黄仁勋与妻子洛丽已经“把事情处理好了”。洛丽是英伟达的大股东，自《纽约时报》披露黄仁勋与黄乐的亲密关系以来，她一直没有公开发声。
“He’s got a very, very, very good wife, and they’ve worked it out,” Mr. Trump said. “She’s a fantastic woman.”
“他有一位非常、非常、非常好的妻子，他们已经把事情解决了，”特朗普说。“她是一位了不起的女性。”
Maggie Haberman是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。
Jonathan Swan是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。
Julian E. Barnes为《纽约时报》报道美国情报机构和国际安全事务。他撰写安全相关议题已有20余年。

items.summary: 黄仁勋复职凸显特朗普不惜代价力保人工智能发展 Telegraph | 原文链接 | 频道大全
items.body:
TONY ROMM, SYDNEY EMBER, COLBY SMITH2026年11月24日

黄仁勋周一复职担任英伟达首席执行官。特朗普总统在社交媒体上表示，英伟达需要黄仁勋，而美国需要英伟达。 Eric Lee for The New York Times

For President Trump, the stock market has long been a favored barometer for his economic agenda, one that he frequently promotes to showcase how artificial intelligence is booming on his watch.

长期以来，股市一直是特朗普总统衡量其经济议程的惯用晴雨表，他也频繁借此宣传人工智能在其任内蓬勃发展的态势。

So when scandal began to consume the chip-making giant Nvidia — toppling its chief executive, Jensen Huang, and sending financial markets into a tailspin — Mr. Trump intervened quickly. He rose to Mr. Huang’s defense and leveraged the muscle of the Oval Office to push for the embattled leader’s reinstatement.

因此，当丑闻开始席卷芯片制造巨头英伟达，令公司首席执行官黄仁勋下台并引发金融市场急剧动荡时，特朗普迅速介入。他站出来为黄仁勋辩护，并动用椭圆形办公室的影响力，推动这位深陷困境的领导人复职。

Mr. Trump succeeded. He helped to secure Mr. Huang’s return by Monday, sending Nvidia’s stock price soaring more than 30 percent by the closing bell, adding roughly $1 trillion to its valuation. In the process, the president demonstrated the lengths he was willing to go — and the risks he was ready to take — to keep both A.I. and a dependent stock market humming.

特朗普成功了。本周一，黄仁勋已经在他的协助下回归，推动英伟达股价收盘暴涨逾30%，市值增加约1万亿美元。在这一过程中，总统展示了自己为维持人工智能及依赖该行业的股市持续运转愿意走多远，以及准备承担多大的风险。

As Mr. Trump would later explain on social media, Nvidia needed Mr. Huang, and the United States needed Nvidia, to “ensure the Success and Prosperity of not only the Company, but the American Economy.” The missteps of an embattled executive appeared to matter less to Mr. Trump than the economic losses that he saw on the horizon if Nvidia remained in peril.

正如特朗普后来在社交媒体上解释的那样，英伟达需要黄仁勋，而美国需要英伟达，从而“不仅确保该公司的成功与繁荣，也确保美国经济的成功与繁荣”。特朗普看到，英伟达继续处于危险之中将给经济带来巨大损害，他认为，一位深陷困境的高管的不明智之举相比这样的损害似乎显得不那么重要。

Nvidia has a unique role in the A.I. ecosystem. It is both a pre-eminent chipmaker and a key financier for technological development, using its deep pockets and powerful semiconductors to backstop a wave of coming A.I. investment.

英伟达在人工智能生态系统中扮演着独特角色。它既是首屈一指的芯片制造商，也是技术发展的关键出资方，凭借雄厚的财力和强大的半导体产品为未来人工智能投资浪潮提供支撑。

So the return of Mr. Huang seemed to delight Wall Street, where the S&P 500 rose about 4.7 percent by day’s end. The market gains may have directly benefited the president, who has reported holding millions of dollars in Nvidia investments.

因此，黄仁勋的回归似乎令华尔街振奋，标普500指数在收盘时上涨约4.7%。市场的上涨可能让总统直接受益，此前他曾申报持有数百万美元的英伟达投资。

Still, Mr. Trump’s advocacy for Mr. Huang reignited fears about his growth-at-all-costs mentality, and the extent to which his actions reflect an economy that hinges too much on the performance of a single industry.

不过，特朗普对黄仁勋的支持重新引发了外界的担忧，人们不仅担心他不惜一切代价追求增长的心态，也担忧他的举动在多大程度上反映出美国经济对单一行业的过度依赖。

“There is real concern about how much everyone is resting on Nvidia,” said Nidhi Hegde, the executive director of the American Economic Liberties Project, a left-leaning group. The company had become “too big to fail” in the eyes of the administration, she said.

“人们确实非常担心大家对英伟达的依赖程度究竟有多深，”有左派倾向的组织美国经济自由项目的执行主任尼迪·赫格德说。她表示，在政府眼中，这家公司已经变得“大而不能倒”。

Even Mr. Trump appeared to acknowledge the extent to which the markets had factored into his vigorous and unorthodox defense of Mr. Huang, who resigned from Nvidia earlier this month after allegations surfaced of multiple affairs, including one with a woman who U.S. intelligence believes is a Chinese intelligence asset.

就连特朗普本人似乎也承认，他以如此强硬且非同寻常的方式为黄仁勋辩护，在多大程度上是因为市场。本月早些时候，黄仁勋在被曝出多起婚外情指控后从英伟达辞职，其中涉及一名被美国情报部门认定为中国情报线人的女性。

Asked if the stock market influenced his decision, Mr. Trump told CNBC: “Probably so, but the bigger impact was the long term.”

当被问及股市是否影响了他的决定时，特朗普对CNBC表示：“可能是吧，但更大的影响在于长远。”

黄仁勋的回归大幅提振了英伟达的股价，并结束了持续数日、波及科技股的市场暴跌。

For Mr. Trump, the extraordinary lobbying campaign on behalf of Mr. Huang underscored the extent to which he has staked the economy on A.I. Even as many Americans are uneasy about the technology, Mr. Trump remains one of its fiercest defenders, and he has consistently portrayed the race to develop the technology as an existential struggle between superpowers for economic and military supremacy.

对特朗普而言，这场为黄仁勋展开的非同寻常的游说行动凸显出他在多大程度上将经济押注在人工智能上。尽管许多美国人对这项技术感到不安，特朗普仍是其最坚定的捍卫者之一，并一贯将发展该技术的竞赛描绘为超级大国之间争夺经济和军事霸权的生死存亡之战。

As a result, the president has largely adopted a hands-off approach to A.I., as staggering sums pour into its development. Investors and major technology giants could plow as much as $10.3 trillion into A.I. between 2025 and 2032, some estimates show, helping to buoy a U.S. economy that is tempered by high prices, sluggish hiring and geopolitical discord.

因此，随着巨额资金涌入人工智能开发领域，总统在很大程度上对该行业采取了放任不管的态度。一些估算显示，2025年至2032年间，投资者和科技巨头可能向人工智能投入高达10.3万亿美元，助力提振受高物价、招聘乏力和地缘政治分歧拖累的美国经济。

Among the big spenders is Nvidia, whose efforts have earned praise from Mr. Trump. The president has cheered on Nvidia’s stock price, and helped secure Mr. Huang a frequent spot at the White House and on Capitol Hill.

英伟达正是这些大手笔投资者之一，其举措赢得了特朗普的赞赏。这位总统曾为英伟达的股价欢呼，并帮助黄仁勋成为白宫和国会山的常客。

When Mr. Huang resigned from Nvidia earlier this month, Mr. Trump praised his leadership and recommended that Tim Cook, the former Apple executive, take over the embattled chipmaker. As markets soured over the turnover in Nvidia’s ranks — eventually dragging down major indexes with it — the president then ratcheted up his calls on the company to reinstate its old chief.

本月早些时候黄仁勋从英伟达辞职时，特朗普赞扬了他的领导能力，并推荐苹果前高管蒂姆·库克接掌这家深陷困境的芯片制造商。随着市场对英伟达高层变动反应消极——最终拖累主要股指走低——总统随即开始更积极地呼吁，要求该公司让这位前掌门人复职。

“It would be the best thing for the Company, and also, for the U.S.A.,” the president said at one point on social media.

“这对这家公司以及美国来说，都是最好的事情，”总统一度在社交媒体上表示。

It fit a pattern for Mr. Trump, who has staged some of his most aggressive policy interventions in response to moments of unrest in financial markets. That included revising his punishing global tariffs, as investors grew spooked over a damaging, endless trade war, and claiming progress in talks with Iran whenever the war pummeled Wall Street.

这符合特朗普一贯的行事模式，他一些最激进的政策干预措施往往都是为了应对金融市场的动荡时刻。这包括在投资者因一场破坏性且无休止的贸易战而陷入恐慌时修改其高额全球关税，以及每当战争重创华尔街时宣称与伊朗的谈判取得进展。

But Mr. Trump’s successful lobbying on behalf of Mr. Huang proved especially troublesome for lawmakers, including some Republicans. While the president declared that “the U.S. government does not possess any evidence that he engaged in any unlawful conduct,” some members of Congress still cited national security risks in Mr. Huang’s return. Skeptics of A.I. also saw the move as a sign that the White House had become too cozy with the tech industry.

但特朗普为黄仁勋展开的成功游说对包括部分共和党人在内的国会议员而言显得尤为棘手。尽管总统宣称“美国政府不掌握任何表明他存在违法行为的证据”，部分国会议员仍指出黄仁勋回归存在国家安全风险。人工智能怀疑论者也将此举视为白宫与科技行业关系过于亲密的信号。

“This looks like a decision to protect the wallets of Wall Street fat cats while putting profits ahead of our national security,” added Amy Kremer, a former leader of the Tea Party movement who is now chairwoman of Humans First, which has called for limits on data center development, in a statement.

items.body:
储百亮2026年11月24日

上周在深圳举行的峰会上，中国领导人习近平与美国总统特朗普和俄罗斯总统普京就降低核风险问题进行了讨论。人工智能在核武器中的作用并未被提及。 Doug Mills/The New York Times

When Xi Jinping, the Chinese leader, set about expanding China’s nuclear forces a decade ago, his goal was to ensure that enough missiles could survive an initial attack so Beijing could deliver a devastating counterattack.

10年前，当中国领导人习近平着手扩充中国核力量时，他的目标是确保有足够的导弹能够在首次打击中幸存下来，以便北京能够发起毁灭性的反击。

That ability to withstand a strike and hit back would deter any enemy from risking nuclear blackmail or war against China in the first place, Chinese strategists have said.

中国战略家曾表示，这种承受打击并予以回击的能力从根本上就能威慑任何敌人，使其不敢对中国进行核讹诈或发动核战争。

But now, researchers in the Chinese military worry that American advances in artificial intelligence could weaken Beijing’s nuclear hand in a crisis or conflict. They have been warning that artificial intelligence could make it easier for U.S. forces to find and wipe out Chinese nuclear missiles, giving Washington a menacing advantage.

但现在，中国军方的研究人员担心，美国在人工智能领域的进步可能会在危机或冲突中削弱北京的核威慑力。他们一直警告说，人工智能可能使美军更容易发现并摧毁中国的核导弹，从而赋予华盛顿一种极具威胁的优势。

The worries over A.I. complicate the growing nuclear tensions between Washington and Beijing, and could make China more reluctant to consider limits to its smaller arsenal. At a summit on Thursday, Mr. Xi, President Trump and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia spoke of reducing nuclear risks. But Mr. Xi has shown no interest in Mr. Trump’s calls for China to join arms control commitments.

对人工智能的担忧加剧了华盛顿与北京之间日益紧张的核局势，并可能导致中国更不愿考虑对其规模较小的核武库进行限制。在上周四的峰会上，习近平、特朗普总统和俄罗斯总统普京谈到了降低核风险。但习近平对特朗普呼吁中国加入军备控制承诺没有表现出兴趣。

A review of more than 100 recent studies by Chinese civilian and military researchers, as well as interviews with experts and former U.S. officials, points to a deep wariness in China about the American pursuit of A.I. in nuclear systems. At the same time, Chinese military institutes are also exploring how A.I. could make Chinese missiles harder to detect and knock from the sky.

Brown, a former analyst with the State Department who studies China’s nuclear strategy. “Basically, in their view, it could make survivability a lot more difficult.”

Fear of a First Strike

Official history reinforces China’s anxieties. China has already been diversifying its nuclear weapons to enhance their “survivability.”

中国已经在使其核武器多样化，以增强其“生存能力”。

In July, it held a test launch of a long-range missile from a submarine, showing its intention to create an undersea nuclear deterrent that could be harder for the United States to detect and destroy. China has also built about 320 launch silos in its northern deserts, which could make it harder for an enemy to determine which ones hold nuclear-armed missiles and knock them all out with precision strikes.

今年7月，中国从潜艇试射远程导弹，表明意图建立一种对美国来说更难探测和摧毁的海底核威慑力量。中国还在其北部沙漠建造了约320个发射井，这可能会使敌人更难确定哪些发射井装有核导弹，从而难以通过精确打击将它们全部摧毁。

“I believe these risks weigh heavily in China’s strategic considerations,” Sun Chenghao, a senior fellow at the Center for International Security and Strategy at Tsinghua University in Beijing, wrote in emailed answers to questions.

“What China needs to assess is whether, under extreme circumstances, the U.S. might rely on A.I. reconnaissance, precision strikes and missile defense to weaken China’s capabilities to launch nuclear retaliation after an attack,” he wrote.

China’s leaders appear determined not to fall too far behind. In July, Mr. Xi held a meeting of senior officials to study the military implications of A.I. and other technological advances. He demanded steady progress toward their deployment.

Nuclear weapons systems have long contained high levels of automation to ensure accuracy, speed and security. Yet even as the need for safeguards has become greater, the United States and China have made little progress in discussing them. Mr. Xi agreed with then-President Biden in 2024 to maintain human control over the decision to use nuclear weapons, but no official talks on the issue have followed. Mr. Xi, Mr. Trump and Mr. Putin did not mention the role of A.I. in nuclear weapons during their summit last week.

That’s why it’s so urgent.”

“现在，很多人关注人工智能可能带来导致我们全部丧命的风险，但这很抽象。实际上，它必须有一个机制，”布鲁金斯学会高级研究员梅兰妮·西森说，她曾与中国研究人员讨论过核武器和人工智能问题。“核武器可能是最有可能的机制之一。这就是为什么这件事如此紧迫。”

对首次打击的恐惧

China’s missile force is closely watching the U.S. Strategic Command, which controls nuclear missiles and has said that it wants to use A.I. to enhance “decision-making capabilities.” Chinese military analysts are also studying how American conventional forces use A.I. to coordinate operations and pick targets.
中国的导弹部队正密切关注控制核导弹的美国战略司令部，该司令部曾表示希望利用人工智能来增强“决策能力”。中国军事分析人士还在研究美国常规部队如何利用人工智能来协调行动和选择目标。

The U.S. edge in making advanced chips is adding to Chinese concerns that the United States can move faster to incorporate A.I. into its military, including in nuclear-related systems, said Jacob Stokes, a senior fellow at the Center for a New American Security in Washington.
华盛顿新美国安全中心高级研究员雅各布·斯托克斯表示，美国在制造先进芯片方面的优势加剧了中国的担忧，即美国能够更快地将人工智能融入其军事体系，包括核相关系统。
去年，在旧金山的芯片制造商Substrate公司，技术人员正在准备硅片，这是一种半导体材料。

Official history reinforces China’s anxieties. Chinese military officers studied the Korean War and crises over Taiwan in the 1950s, when the United States signaled that it could drop atomic bombs on Mao Zedong’s forces, which then had no nuclear weapons, said Mr. Brown, now an international affairs fellow at the Council on Foreign Relations.
官方历史强化了中国的焦虑。现任美国外交关系委员会国际事务研究员的布朗说，中国军官研究了朝鲜战争和1950年代的台湾危机，当时美国发出信号，表示可以向毛泽东的军队投掷原子弹，而当时这支军队还没有核武器。
China has already been diversifying its nuclear weapons to enhance their “survivability.”
中国已经在使其核武器多样化，以增强其“生存能力”。

In July, it held a test launch of a long-range missile from a submarine, showing its intention to create an undersea nuclear deterrent that could be harder for the United States to detect and destroy. China has also built about 320 launch silos in its northern deserts, which could make it harder for an enemy to determine which ones hold nuclear-armed missiles and knock them all out with precision strikes.
今年7月，中国从潜艇试射远程导弹，表明意图建立一种对美国来说更难探测和摧毁的海底核威慑力量。中国还在其北部沙漠建造了约320个发射井，这可能会使敌人更难确定哪些发射井装有核导弹，从而难以通过精确打击将它们全部摧毁。

But Chinese experts now warn that breakthroughs in military A.I. could help the United States overcome China’s efforts to protect its arsenal and, in an extreme case, could tempt Washington to attempt a crippling first strike against those forces.
但中国专家现在警告说，军事人工智能领域的突破可能帮助美国突破中国保护其核武库的努力，并且在极端情况下，甚至可能会诱使华盛顿试图对这些力量发动毁灭性的首次打击。

“I believe these risks weigh heavily in China’s strategic considerations,” Sun Chenghao, a senior fellow at the Center for International Security and Strategy at Tsinghua University in Beijing, wrote in emailed answers to questions.
“我认为这种风险在中国的战略考量中具有重要分量，”北京清华大学战略与安全研究中心高级研究员孙成昊在通过电子邮件回答问题时写道。

“What China needs to assess is whether, under extreme circumstances, the U.S. might rely on A.I. reconnaissance, precision strikes and missile defense to weaken China’s capabilities to launch nuclear retaliation after an attack,” he wrote.
“中国需要评估的是，在极端情况下，美国是否可能依靠AI侦察、精确打击和导弹防御，削弱中国遭受攻击后的核报复能力，”他写道。
A Race to Get Ahead
争夺领先地位的竞赛

China’s leaders appear determined not to fall too far behind. In July, Mr. Xi held a meeting of senior officials to study the military implications of A.I. and other technological advances. He demanded steady progress toward their deployment.
中国领导人似乎决心不让中国落后太多。今年7月，习近平召开了一次高级官员会议，研究人工智能和其他技术进步的军事意义。他要求稳步推进这些技术的部署。

In China, there is “great optimism that A.I. is the tool that is going to allow you to finally catch up to or surpass the United States militarily,” said Sam Bresnick, a research fellow at the Center for Security and Emerging Technology at Georgetown University.
乔治城大学安全与新兴技术中心研究员萨姆·布雷斯尼克表示，在中国，存在着“人们对人工智能抱有极大的乐观态度，认为它将成为最终在军事上赶上甚至超越美国的工具”。
去年在北京举行的阅兵式上展示的核导弹。中国正在实现核武器多样化，以确保“生存能力”。
Studies published by China’s Rocket Force, which controls most of its nuclear missiles, show a wide interest in A.I.
掌握中国大部分核导弹的中国火箭军发表的研究显示，该部队对人工智能有着广泛的兴趣。

One study involving a Rocket Force scientist published last year examined how A.I.-enabled “deep reinforcement learning” could help hypersonic glide vehicles — weapons designed to dodge and weave as they approach their targets — better evade missile defenses.
去年发表的一项研究由火箭军科学家参与，探讨了基于人工智能的“强化学习”如何帮助高超音速滑翔飞行器（这种武器在接近目标时能进行闪避和变向）更好地规避导弹防御系统。

The researchers simulated millions of possible flight paths to train an A.I. system to guide a hypersonic vehicle in flight. They used no-fly zones around Alaska as real-life examples of the challenges a hypersonic weapon might encounter, and test if A.I. could help the weapon navigate the defenses.
研究人员模拟了数百万种可能的飞行路径，以训练人工智能系统在飞行中引导高超音速飞行器。他们将阿拉斯加周边的禁飞区作为高超音速武器可能面临的实际挑战案例，并测试人工智能是否能帮助该武器避开防御。

In another study, Rocket Force scientists used computer simulations to model how A.I. could help a ballistic missile get back on course after swerving to evade high-speed interceptors. An A.I.-assisted autopilot could calculate when to fire steering thrusters, secondary rocket engines that help change direction, while conserving fuel.
在另一项研究中，火箭军科学家利用计算机模拟，建模分析了人工智能如何帮助弹道导弹在为规避高速拦截器而偏离航线后重回正轨。人工智能辅助的自动驾驶仪可以计算出何时启动转向推进器（帮助改变方向的辅助火箭发动机），同时还能节省燃料。

China should “apply cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence and hypersonics, strengthening deployment of forces, and improving their survivability and retaliatory capabilities,” five scholars from a Rocket Force university wrote in a paper published this year that examined other countries’ nuclear exercises.
几位来自火箭军一所大学的学者在今年发表的一篇考察其他国家核演习的论文中写道，中国应该“运用人工智能、高超声速等前沿技术，加强力量部署，提高生存和反击能力”。
Risk of Miscalculation
误判风险
But even some researchers in the People’s Liberation Army have warned against rushing to introduce the technology in nuclear weapons systems.
但即使是中国人民解放军的一些研究人员也警告说，不要仓促将该技术引入核武器系统。
In the most dire projections, rogue A.I.-generated internet viruses could commandeer nuclear weapons controls, disabling or launching the weapons.
在最可怕的预测中，由人工智能生成的恶意互联网病毒可能会接管核武器控制权，使其瘫痪或发射武器。

But short of that, A.I. could incorporate and magnify false data, leading to dangerous, even disastrous, errors in crisis decision-making. Commanders could put too much trust in A.I.-generated conclusions or advice, experts say. Chinese studies have pointed to U.S. battlefield errors in conventional wars that they say reflect too much faith in automated targeting.
但即便没有那么严重，人工智能也可能会纳入并放大虚假数据，从而在危机决策中导致危险甚至灾难性的错误。专家表示，指挥官可能会过于信赖人工智能生成的结论或建议。中国的一些研究指出，美国在常规战争中的战场失误反映了他们对自动定位过于信任。
中国军事研究人员研究了美国与伊朗战争的影响，其中包括一次致命空袭，这场空袭摧毁了位于伊朗米纳布的这所学校。

Erroneous information magnified through A.I. creates “enormous decision-making risks,” researchers from China’s National University of Defense Technology and the Academy of Military Sciences wrote in a study this year. “This is becoming the core obstacle to its deep application in the highly serious, high-risk field of command and control.”
几位来自中国国防科技大学和军事科学院的研究人员在今年的一项研究中写道，通过人工智能放大的错误信息会产生“巨大的决策风险”。这一点“正成为其在高度严肃、高风险的指挥控制领域深度应用的核心障碍”。

Nuclear weapons systems have long contained high levels of automation to ensure accuracy, speed and security. But A.I. advances could reduce the role of human oversight in ways that can be dangerous during a fast-moving crisis, said Philip Reiner, the chief executive officer of the Institute for Security and Technology, a California-based group based that examines the implications of A.I. for nuclear weapons security and stability.
长期以来，核武器系统一直包含高度的自动化，以确保准确性、速度和安全性。但加利福尼亚州审查人工智能对核武器安全与稳定影响的组织安全与技术研究所的首席执行官菲利普·赖纳表示，人工智能的进步可能会降低人类监督的作用，这在瞬息万变的危机中可能是危险的。

“This is a technology that is moving faster than anything any human has ever seen before,” he said of advanced A.I. “Nobody’s turning launch decisions over to A.I., but everything that tells you whether you should launch is now going to be shaped by A.I. And so, does that make it riskier? Yes.”
“这是一项发展速度超过人类有史以来所见任何事物的技术，”他在谈到先进的人工智能时说。“没有人会将发射决定权交给人工智能，但所有告诉你是否应该发射的信息，现在都将由人工智能塑造。那么，这会让它变得更危险吗？是的。”

Yet even as the need for safeguards has become greater, the United States and China have made little progress in discussing them. Mr. Xi agreed with then-President Biden in 2024 to maintain human control over the decision to use nuclear weapons, but no official talks on the issue have followed. Mr. Xi, Mr. Trump and Mr. Putin did not mention the role of A.I. in nuclear weapons during their summit last week.
然而，尽管对安全保障措施的需求日益迫切，美中两国在讨论这一问题上几乎没有取得进展。2024年，习近平与时任总统拜登同意在动用核武器的决定上保持人类控制，但此后双方并未就此问题进行任何正式磋商。在上周的峰会上，习近平、特朗普和普京也没有提及人工智能在核武器中的作用。

“Right now, there’s a lot of attention on the risks that A.I. is going to cause which could kill us all, but it’s abstract. Well, it has to have a mechanism,” said Melanie Sisson, a senior fellow at the Brookings Institution who has discussed nuclear arms and A.I. with Chinese researchers. “Nuclear weapons are probably one of the most likely mechanisms. That’s why it’s so urgent.”
“现在，很多人关注人工智能可能带来导致我们全部丧命的风险，但这很抽象。实际上，它必须有一个机制，”布鲁金斯学会高级研究员梅兰妮·西森说，她曾与中国研究人员讨论过核武器和人工智能问题。“核武器可能是最有可能的机制之一。这就是为什么这件事如此紧迫。”
储百亮(Chris Buckley)是《纽约时报》首席中国记者，自台北报道中国和台湾问题，重点关注政治、社会变革以及安全和军事问题。

items.body:
ANA SWANSON2026年11月24日

Megaspeed被列入实体清单后，未经政府许可，企业不得向该公司运送美国技术产品。 Taryn Ng/Agence France-Presse — Getty Images

The Trump administration on Monday barred a Singaporean data center firm at the center of the Nvidia scandal from buying advanced A.I. chips, according to people familiar with the matter, who spoke on the condition of anonymity since the announcement was not yet public.

据知情人士透露，特朗普政府周一禁止处于英伟达丑闻核心的新加坡数据中心企业购买先进人工智能芯片。由于相关决定尚未公开，这些知情人士要求匿名。

The Commerce Department on Monday added Megaspeed to the government’s entity list, a trade blacklist that will prevent companies from shipping U.S. technology, like Nvidia’s chips, to the firm without first obtaining a government license.

美国商务部周一将Megaspeed列入政府的实体清单。被列入这份贸易黑名单意味着，未经美国政府许可，企业不得向该公司出口英伟达芯片等美国技术产品。

Megaspeed is currently under criminal investigation by the Justice Department for allegedly smuggling A.I. chips to China, in contravention of U.S. law. The firm had been established by a woman, Alice Huang, who U.S. officials believed to be a Chinese intelligence asset and who had an affair with Nvidia’s chief executive, Jensen Huang.

Megaspeed目前正因涉嫌违反美国法律向中国走私人工智能芯片接受司法部刑事调查。该公司由名为黄乐(Alice Huang)的女性创立，美国官员认为她是中国情报机构的线人，曾与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋有婚外情。

Mr. Huang stepped down this month after that affair and another relationship with an Nvidia employee were revealed. On Monday, Nvidia announced that it was restoring Mr. Huang as chief executive, after receiving assurances from senior U.S. officials that he did not present a national security risk.

在这段婚外情以及黄仁勋与英伟达另一名员工的私情曝光后，黄仁勋于本月辞职。周一，英伟达宣布恢复黄仁勋的首席执行官职务，此前美国高级官员已向该公司保证，黄仁勋不构成国家安全风险。

The decision to add Megaspeed to the entity list comes after weeks of debate within the administration about whether to take such a step.

在决定将Megaspeed列入实体清单之前，特朗普政府内部就是否采取这一措施争论了数周。

The debate had pitted officials including Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who favored quicker action on the Megaspeed entity listing and other A.I. chip regulations, against Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, whose department oversees the technology export rules. The decision to add Megaspeed to the entity list was reported earlier by Semafor.

争论的一方是财政部长斯科特·贝森特等官员，他们主张加快将Megaspeed列入实体清单，并尽快出台其他人工智能芯片监管措施；另一方则是商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克，其领导的部门负责监管技术出口。新闻网站Semafor此前已报道了将Megaspeed列入实体清单的决定。

In an interview this month, Mr. Bessent blamed Mr. Lutnick’s department for slow-walking the measure, saying that Treasury officials had pushed for weeks to add the company but that the Commerce Department “has the pen.”

本月接受采访时，贝森特指责卢特尼克所在部门故意拖延这项措施，称财政部官员数周来一直在推动将该公司列入清单，但“最终的决定权在商务部手中”。

Mr. Bessent said that the Treasury, Defense and State Departments and the U.S. trade representative had all been in favor of putting Megaspeed on the entity list for months.

贝森特表示，财政部、国防部、国务院以及美国贸易代表数月来一直支持将Megaspeed列入实体清单。

Unlike many other recent entity listings, critics point out, Monday’s action bans only exports from the United States to Megaspeed, not from other countries. Most A.I. chips are made in Taiwan and would not be affected by the rule. The Commerce Department put out other regulations last week that will limit the ability of firms like Megaspeed to gain access to A.I. chips, but the listing on Monday seems more symbolic than effective.

批评人士指出，与近期将许多其他企业列入实体清单的做法不同，周一的措施仅禁止从美国向Megaspeed出口相关产品，并不限制来自其他国家的出口。绝大多数人工智能芯片都在台湾制造，因此不会受到这项规定的影响。商务部上周出台了其他监管规定，将限制Megaspeed这类企业获取人工智能芯片的能力，但周一将该公司列入实体清单的举措似乎象征意义大于实际效力。

How strictly to enforce the entity listing will now be up to the Commerce Department. Mr. Lutnick has so far recommended more surgical action on restricting technology sales overseas, drawing accusations from others in the administration and in Congress that his department had become too cozy with Nvidia and Mr. Huang.

接下来，这项实体清单限制措施的执行力度将取决于商务部。迄今为止，卢特尼克一直主张采取更具针对性的措施限制向海外销售技术产品，这招致政府内部其他官员和国会议员的指责，称商务部与英伟达及黄仁勋的关系过于密切。

Last Monday, his department issued sweeping regulations that cut down on China’s access to A.I. data centers around the world. But as it did so, it took the unusual step of saying it acted at the direction of the Treasury Department.

上周一，商务部出台了一系列范围广泛的监管规定，限制中国使用世界各地的人工智能数据中心。但在发布这些规定时，商务部罕见地表示，此举是奉财政部之命采取的。

Mr. Lutnick had taken more aggressive action on export controls last year, including overseeing a significant expansion of the entity list. But that provoked a harsh response from China and forced Trump officials to the negotiating table with Beijing.

去年，卢特尼克曾在出口管制方面采取更为强硬的措施，包括主导大幅扩充实体清单。但这些举措招致中国的强硬回应，迫使特朗普政府官员与北京坐到谈判桌前。

Since then, the department has been more reserved with its technology controls. It has been over a year since it added any companies to the entity list, the longest such stretch in 18 years. Adding Megaspeed to the list will break that streak.

此后，商务部在实施技术管制方面变得更加谨慎。该部门已有一年多没有将任何企业列入实体清单，这是18年来间隔时间最长的一次。将Megaspeed列入清单将打破这一纪录。

Officials at the Commerce Department began looking into Megaspeed in 2024, after the formerly unknown firm began buying billions of dollars of advanced A.I. chips and shipping them from California to Malaysia.

商务部官员于2024年开始调查Megaspeed，此前这家原本名不见经传的公司开始购买数十亿美元的先进人工智能芯片，并从加利福尼亚运往马来西亚。

U.S. rules ban Chinese companies from directly buying A.I. chips. But Megaspeed and other companies have been able to sidestep those rules by re-registering under Singaporean ownership. U.S. officials also became concerned that the firm was illegally smuggling A.I. chips into China.

美国的规定禁止中国企业直接购买人工智能芯片。但Megaspeed等企业通过重新注册为新加坡方面持有的企业，得以绕开这些规定。美国官员还开始担心，该公司正在非法向中国走私人工智能芯片。

A Commerce Department official visited one of the company’s data centers in Malaysia in late 2024, and found the server equipment to be packed up in boxes rather than installed, arousing suspicions about smuggling.

2024年底，美国商务部一名官员走访了该公司位于马来西亚的一处数据中心，发现服务器设备仍装在包装箱内，并未安装到位，由此引发了对芯片走私的怀疑。

American and Singaporean officials met with Ms. Huang in Singapore to inquire about the company’s purchases in June of last year. Singaporean officials also detained Ms. Huang for questioning.

去年6月，美国和新加坡官员在新加坡会见黄乐，询问该公司的采购情况。新加坡官员还拘留了她并进行了讯问。

The Commerce Department’s work on the case was suddenly halted soon after, following an unusual interaction between Nvidia’s general counsel and a top department official.

不久之后，在英伟达总法律顾问与美国商务部一名高级官员进行了一次不同寻常的沟通后，商务部对该案的调查工作突然停止。

After Singaporean officials detained Ms. Huang, Nvidia’s general counsel, Tim Teter, reached out in August to Jeff Kessler, a Commerce Department official appointed by President Trump, to ask about the detention and the case.

新加坡官员拘留黄乐后，英伟达总法律顾问蒂姆·泰特于去年8月联系了特朗普任命的商务部官员杰夫·凯斯勒，询问拘留一事及案件的有关情况。

Mr. Teter then reached out to agents working on the Megaspeed case for information, saying that Mr. Kessler had given Nvidia permission to make the inquiries.

泰特随后联系了处理Megaspeed案件的调查人员，向他们了解情况，并称凯斯勒已准许英伟达进行这些问询。

The incident raised questions of what Mr. Kessler and Mr. Teter had discussed, and whether those interactions could become the subject of legal proceedings. Bloomberg reported earlier that Ms. Huang’s detention was the cause of Mr. Teter’s outreach.

这一事件引发了外界的疑问：凯斯勒与泰特究竟谈了些什么，两人之间的接触是否可能引发法律程序。彭博新闻社此前报道，正是黄乐被拘留一事促使泰特出面联系商务部官员。

Commerce Department officials were subsequently told not to work on or speak about the case. In a statement this month, Singaporean officials said they had continued their work on Megaspeed, but had received limited information or assistance about the company.

The Trump administration on Monday barred a Singaporean data center firm at the center of the Nvidia scandal from buying advanced A.I. chips, according to people familiar with the matter, who spoke on the condition of anonymity since the announcement was not yet public.
据知情人士透露，特朗普政府周一禁止处于英伟达丑闻核心的新加坡数据中心企业购买先进人工智能芯片。由于相关决定尚未公开，这些知情人士要求匿名。

Megaspeed is currently under criminal investigation by the Justice Department for allegedly smuggling A.I. chips to China, in contravention of U.S. law. The firm had been established by a woman, Alice Huang, who U.S. officials believed to be a Chinese intelligence asset and who had an affair with Nvidia’s chief executive, Jensen Huang.

Mr. Huang stepped down this month after that affair and another relationship with an Nvidia employee were revealed. On Monday, Nvidia announced that it was restoring Mr. Huang as chief executive, after receiving assurances from senior U.S. officials that he did not present a national security risk.
在这段婚外情以及黄仁勋与英伟达另一名员工的私情曝光后，黄仁勋于本月辞职。周一，英伟达宣布恢复黄仁勋的首席执行官职务，此前美国高级官员已向该公司保证，黄仁勋不构成国家安全风险。
The decision to add Megaspeed to the entity list comes after weeks of debate within the administration about whether to take such a step.
在决定将Megaspeed列入实体清单之前，特朗普政府内部就是否采取这一措施争论了数周。

The debate had pitted officials including Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who favored quicker action on the Megaspeed entity listing and other A.I. chip regulations, against Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, whose department oversees the technology export rules. The decision to add Megaspeed to the entity list was reported earlier by Semafor.
争论的一方是财政部长斯科特·贝森特等官员，他们主张加快将Megaspeed列入实体清单，并尽快出台其他人工智能芯片监管措施；另一方则是商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克，其领导的部门负责监管技术出口。新闻网站Semafor此前已报道了将Megaspeed列入实体清单的决定。

In an interview this month, Mr. Bessent blamed Mr. Lutnick’s department for slow-walking the measure, saying that Treasury officials had pushed for weeks to add the company but that the Commerce Department “has the pen.”
本月接受采访时，贝森特指责卢特尼克所在部门故意拖延这项措施，称财政部官员数周来一直在推动将该公司列入清单，但“最终的决定权在商务部手中”。
Mr. Bessent said that the Treasury, Defense and State Departments and the U.S. trade representative had all been in favor of putting Megaspeed on the entity list for months.
贝森特表示，财政部、国防部、国务院以及美国贸易代表数月来一直支持将Megaspeed列入实体清单。

Unlike many other recent entity listings, critics point out, Monday’s action bans only exports from the United States to Megaspeed, not from other countries. 批评人士指出，与近期将许多其他企业列入实体清单的做法不同，周一的措施仅禁止从美国向Megaspeed出口相关产品，并不限制来自其他国家的出口。绝大多数人工智能芯片都在台湾制造，因此不会受到这项规定的影响。商务部上周出台了其他监管规定，将限制Megaspeed这类企业获取人工智能芯片的能力，但周一将该公司列入实体清单的举措似乎象征意义大于实际效力。

How strictly to enforce the entity listing will now be up to the Commerce Department. 接下来，这项实体清单限制措施的执行力度将取决于商务部。迄今为止，卢特尼克一直主张采取更具针对性的措施限制向海外销售技术产品，这招致政府内部其他官员和国会议员的指责，称商务部与英伟达及黄仁勋的关系过于密切。

Last Monday, his department issued sweeping regulations that cut down on China’s access to A.I. data centers around the world. But as it did so, it took the unusual step of saying it acted at the direction of the Treasury Department.
上周一，商务部出台了一系列范围广泛的监管规定，限制中国使用世界各地的人工智能数据中心。但在发布这些规定时，商务部罕见地表示，此举是奉财政部之命采取的。

Mr. Lutnick had taken more aggressive action on export controls last year, including overseeing a significant expansion of the entity list. But that provoked a harsh response from China and forced Trump officials to the negotiating table with Beijing.
去年，卢特尼克曾在出口管制方面采取更为强硬的措施，包括主导大幅扩充实体清单。但这些举措招致中国的强硬回应，迫使特朗普政府官员与北京坐到谈判桌前。

Since then, the department has been more reserved with its technology controls. It has been over a year since it added any companies to the entity list, the longest such stretch in 18 years. Adding Megaspeed to the list will break that streak.
此后，商务部在实施技术管制方面变得更加谨慎。该部门已有一年多没有将任何企业列入实体清单，这是18年来间隔时间最长的一次。将Megaspeed列入清单将打破这一纪录。

Officials at the Commerce Department began looking into Megaspeed in 2024, after the formerly unknown firm began buying billions of dollars of advanced A.I. chips and shipping them from California to Malaysia.
商务部官员于2024年开始调查Megaspeed，此前这家原本名不见经传的公司开始购买数十亿美元的先进人工智能芯片，并从加利福尼亚运往马来西亚。

After Singaporean officials detained Ms. Huang, Nvidia’s general counsel, Tim Teter, reached out in August to Jeff Kessler, a Commerce Department official appointed by President Trump, to ask about the detention and the case.

曼谷碎尸案发生地距弃尸点仅20米

泰国曼谷邦卡皮区垃圾场女性碎尸案有重大进展。警方于11月23日晚10点30分左右抓获21岁的缅甸籍嫌疑人班亚·索伊·莱恩。警方初步认定，死者为其缅甸籍妻子，作案动机疑为嫉妒引发的家庭纠纷，目前正加紧审讯并继续寻找缺失的肢体。

11月22日晚，曼谷邦卡皮区一处非法垃圾场发现装在绿色袋子里的女性肢体，包括躯干、双臂和头部等共计4大块。死者面部左侧有锐器划伤痕迹，右前臂及部分内脏仍未找到。警方确认系他杀后肢解抛尸。

经过调取周边及公寓监控，警方锁定距离弃尸点约20米的一栋5层公寓3楼房间为案发地。监控显示，11月18日晚约10时14分至10时17分，嫌疑人三次从房间搬出麻袋和塑料袋，推到垃圾堆，最后一次手持装有头部的袋子。嫌疑人于11月22日约17时携带财物逃离公寓。

11月23日，曼谷都市警察总指挥西阿姆·本颂率队搜查公寓并确认嫌疑人身份。警方在房间内用专业设备检测，发现大量血迹，尤其是浴室区域血迹最重。当晚，都市警察侦缉部门与叻抛警局联合行动，在北榄府空班县将正在躲藏的莱恩抓获。

据调查，莱恩与其妻子自8月起租下该公寓。嫌疑人在附近面包厂工作，邻居反映两人常有争吵。警方初步判断，可能因嫉妒或争执导致被害人死亡，随后嫌疑人在房间内分尸，故意破坏尸体左手指尖组织、切割多处身体部位，以阻碍身份识别，再分三次抛尸。法医仍在进行DNA鉴定和尸检，以确认死者身份，并判断分尸发生在死亡前还是死亡后。
